title: Principal Architect – Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation (Canada)
description:
The Opportunity

Aequilibrium is looking for a Canadian-based Principal Digital Banking Architect (contract-to-hire) to help lead the next generation of digital banking transformation for Canadian credit unions. This is not simply an architecture role. We are looking for a senior technology leader who can sit alongside a credit union CIO or CTO, understand their business and technology landscape, define the path from current to future state, and lead multidisciplinary teams through complex digital banking transformations.

Aequilibrium has more than a decade of experience in credit union digital banking. We helped Central 1 build Forge, deployed and tailored Forge for Canadian credit unions, have delivered VeriPark and Backbase engagements, and are now helping credit unions navigate the next generation of platform modernization.

You will help us lead these transformations and build reusable expertise, accelerators, and architecture patterns that strengthen Aequilibrium's position as a trusted digital banking transformation partner.

What You'll Lead

  • Own architecture and technical leadership for complex digital banking transformations, including Forge-to-VeriPark migrations.

  • Assess current-state environments and define target-state and transition architectures across digital banking, core banking, integration, cloud, data, identity, security and third-party systems.

  • Lead architecture for VeriChannel, VeriLink, Microsoft Azure and Dynamics 365/Power Platform ecosystems.

  • Establish integration and API strategies that connect digital banking platforms with core banking, payments, CRM, identity, fraud, analytics, and other financial-services systems.

  • Lead Design Authority and architecture governance across Aequilibrium, client and vendor teams.

  • Translate complex technical decisions into clear business implications for CIOs, CTOs and other executives.

  • Guide engineering teams from architecture through implementation, testing, migration and go-live.

  • Champion configuration over customization, platform upgradeability, security by design and API-first integration.

  • Mentor solution architects, technical leads and engineers.

Help Build Our Digital Banking Practice

Beyond individual projects, you will help shape Aequilibrium's digital banking architecture capability.

You will:

  • Develop reusable reference architectures, migration playbooks, integration patterns and accelerators.

  • Help define Aequilibrium's point of view on digital banking modernization and platform migration.

  • Participate in strategic pursuits, client workshops and technical presentations.

  • Build trusted relationships across the Canadian credit union ecosystem and with platform and technology partners.

  • Contribute to thought leadership through articles, webinars, conferences, and industry discussions.

  • Help identify emerging opportunities as credit unions modernize legacy platforms, consolidate through mergers, and collaborate through shared technology models.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or senior technology leadership.

  • Significant experience within Canadian credit unions, banking, or financial services.

  • Proven leadership of at least one major digital banking modernization, platform migration, or comparable enterprise transformation from strategy through implementation.

  • Strong understanding of digital banking architecture, core banking integration, payments, identity, security, and member-facing digital channels.

  • Deep expertise in APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, and enterprise integration.

  • Strong Microsoft Azure architecture experience.

  • Ability to move comfortably between executive strategy and detailed technical discussions with engineering teams.

  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture governance and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

  • Excellent communication and executive stakeholder management skills.

Particularly Valuable Experience

  • Hands-on experience with VeriPark, VeriChannel and VeriLink.

  • Experience with Central 1 Forge and the Canadian credit union ecosystem.

  • Experience migrating from Forge or another legacy digital banking platform to VeriPark.

  • Experience with Backbase, ebankIT, Temenos, Intellect Design or other major digital banking platforms.

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform architecture.

  • Relationships within the Canadian credit union, digital banking, or fintech ecosystem.

  • Industry thought leadership, conference speaking, publishing, or participation in banking technology communities.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Established yourself as a trusted architecture advisor to Aequilibrium's credit union clients.

  • Successfully led architecture for one or more major digital banking transformations.

  • Created reusable migration patterns and architecture assets that accelerate future implementations.

  • Strengthened relationships with our digital banking technology partners.

  • Helped Aequilibrium win additional digital banking transformation engagements.

  • Mentored and elevated the architecture and engineering capabilities of the broader AEQ team.

    Compensation

    This is a contract role, with a competitive rate of CAD $80–$110/hour, depending on experience, digital banking expertise, and demonstrated leadership capabilities.

    For exceptional candidates with deep VeriPark, Forge, and Canadian credit union experience, compensation will reflect the strategic value and expertise they bring to Aequilibrium and our clients.

title: IGF Government Relations Coordinator – Africa (Posting Location:  Remote within
description:
This job is open to residents with valid work permits in the following countries: Burkina Faso, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Africa or Uganda

About IISD

The International Institute for Sustainable Development (IISD) is a globally recognized think tank with more than 30 years of experience working to solve today's greatest sustainable development challenges. We combine deep expertise across critical policy areas with a collaborative approach to research, advice, and hands-on support that delivers real-world results. Headquartered in Winnipeg, Manitoba, we are a diverse team of over 300 experts working from offices in Canada and Switzerland as well as other locations around the world.

The Intergovernmental Forum on Mining, Minerals, Metals and Sustainable Development (IGF), hosted by IISD, is an intergovernmental organization dedicated to improving mining governance for sustainable development. Through policy advice, technical assistance, capacity building, and international dialogue, the IGF supports more than 85 member countries in maximizing the contribution of mining to sustainable development.

Scope

The IGF is seeking a Government Relations Coordinator – Africa to lead government engagement and partnerships across the African region.

Working closely with the Director, Government Relations Lead, and technical teams, the successful candidate will strengthen relationships with African member governments, coordinate access to IGF technical assistance and capacity-building activities, develop strategic partnerships, and contribute to expanding IGF's visibility and impact across Africa.

The successful candidate will serve as the primary relationship manager for African member countries and key regional partners, ensuring that governments and strategic partners receive timely, coordinated, and high-quality engagement and support aligned with IGF's strategic priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement strategies to engage, re-engage, and expand IGF membership across Africa.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with member governments, focal points, regional organizations, and development partners.
  • Coordinate government requests for technical assistance and facilitate communication between governments and IGF technical teams.
  • Coordinate African participation in the Annual General Meeting (AGM), Executive Committee activities, regional events, and bilateral meetings.
  • Organize and coordinate consultations with member countries on IGF governance matters, including Executive Committee elections, governance reforms, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Prepare briefing notes, engagement reports, country profiles, and regional analyses.
  • Develop strategic partnerships and support fundraising and donor engagement.
  • Represent the IGF at regional and international meetings and conferences.
  • Collaborate with technical, communications, and project management teams to ensure coordinated delivery of IGF activities.
  • Maintain government engagement records and contribute to monitoring and reporting.
  • The successful candidate will receive a detailed Terms of Reference outlining the full scope of responsibilities.

Knowledge and Qualifications

Essential

  • A Master degree or postgraduate degree in international relations, political science, public administration, law, public policy, sustainable development, mining governance, or another relevant discipline.
  • A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in government relations, diplomacy, stakeholder engagement, international development, or public policy.
  • Experience working with governments, regional organizations, or multilateral institutions, preferably in Africa.
  • Experience coordinating international meetings, technical assistance, or capacity-building initiatives.
  • Excellent organizational, planning and project management skills.

Desirable

  • Experience working on mining governance or sustainable development.
  • Experience working with African regional organizations or development finance institutions.
  • Experience supporting donor engagement and resource mobilization.

Skills, Competencies, and Attributes

Essential

  • Excellent relationship-building and diplomacy skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multicultural environment.
  • Strong political judgment and cultural awareness.
  • Excellent IT skills including proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint)

Languages

  • Excellent written and spoken English and French.
  • Portuguese and/or Arabic are strong assets.
  • Knowledge of additional African languages is an asset.

title: Junior Awards Producer
description:
Junior Awards Producer

£30,000–£35,000 | Full-time | UK-based | Remote

Are you naturally curious? Do you enjoy researching new topics, speaking to people and turning ideas into something tangible? Are you highly organised, great with detail and looking for a role where you can take real ownership from an early stage?

We’re looking for a Junior Awards Producer to join our growing Awards team and help produce industry-leading awards programmes across the UK, Europe and USA.

You don’t need previous awards experience – we’ll teach you that, you do however need to be a graduate, but what matters is that you’re curious, organised, confident communicating with people and excited by the opportunity to take responsibility for your own projects.

What will you be doing?

Our awards portfolio has grown rapidly over the last four years and now includes nine awards programmes across three continents.

As a Junior Awards Producer, you’ll work with our Head of Awards to take an awards programme from initial research and development all the way through to nominations, judging and the final awards ceremony.

This isn’t an event logistics role. Your focus will be on developing the awards programme itself; understanding the market, identifying what and who should be recognised, building relationships with senior industry experts and delivering a credible and engaging awards process.

You’ll:

  • Research specialist industries and speak to senior professionals to understand the trends, developments and innovations shaping their markets.
  • Develop and refine award categories, judging criteria and entry guidelines.
  • Identify and recruit respected industry experts and senior executives to join judging panels.
  • Build relationships with judges and manage the judging process from nominations through to shortlist and winner selection.
  • Drive high-quality nominations through research, direct outreach and engagement with organisations and previous entrants.
  • Work with our Marketing and Editorial teams to promote the awards and build their profile within the industries we serve.
  • Manage multiple awards projects, keeping deadlines, milestones and stakeholders on track.
  • Work with our Events team on the content for the awards ceremony, including scripts, presentations, winner information and running order.
  • Attend and support awards ceremonies in the UK and internationally.

You’ll be given real responsibility early on, while having the support and training you need to learn how successful B2B awards programmes are developed and delivered.

Requirements

Who are we looking for?

You might be a recent graduate looking for your first opportunity, or already have some experience in events, publishing, research, marketing, project coordination or another role where you've developed strong organisational and communication skills.

More important than your exact background is how you approach things.

We think you'll thrive in this role if you:

  • Are naturally curious and enjoy learning about unfamiliar subjects and industries.
  • Love researching, asking questions and getting to the bottom of how things work.
  • Are confident picking up the phone and speaking with people you haven't met before.
  • Can communicate professionally and build relationships with senior people.
  • Are exceptionally organised and enjoy keeping multiple projects moving at the same time.
  • Have excellent attention to detail and care about getting things right.
  • Enjoy taking ownership and responsibility rather than waiting to be told what to do next.
  • Are comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with colleagues.
  • Can adapt when priorities change and deadlines get tight.
  • Are commercially aware and interested in understanding what makes a successful product or event.
  • Enjoy working as part of a team and collaborating across different areas of a business.

It would be great if you also have...

Experience or an interest in B2B events, publishing, awards, conferences or project management would be useful, but none of these are essential.

You may also have:

  • Experience communicating with senior professionals or clients.
  • An interest in insurance, intellectual property, life sciences, legal, financial or professional services.
  • Experience using CRM, project management or awards platforms such as Evessio.
  • Strong copywriting skills and an ability to communicate complex ideas clearly.

Above all, we're interested in your potential. If you're bright, curious, organised and motivated to learn, we don't expect you to arrive knowing everything about awards production.

Benefits

What you'll get from the role

This is an opportunity to develop a broad range of skills early in your career.

You'll gain experience in research, project management, stakeholder management, commercial thinking, content development and event production, while building relationships with senior professionals across international industries.

You'll also have the opportunity to see the projects you've worked on come to life at awards ceremonies in the UK, Europe and USA.

You'll be joining a growing awards portfolio where you'll be trusted with genuine responsibility, supported by an experienced team and given the opportunity to develop as the portfolio continues to grow.

Benefits

Alongside a salary of £30,000–£35,000 and flexible, remote working, we offer a range of benefits designed to support your wellbeing and work-life balance, including unlimited holiday, income protection and death in service insurance, a health cash plan, access to confidential counselling and enhanced family leave.

About Newton Media

Newton Media is a specialist B2B media and events business. We bring professional communities together through trusted information, specialist content, events and awards across markets including insurance, intellectual property and life sciences.

We are a remote-first business and believe in giving people the autonomy and support to take ownership of their work, develop their expertise and make a genuine contribution.

Our values underpin how we work:

Be Friendly | Be Entrepreneurial | Embrace Resilience | Do Good | Demonstrate Integrity Always | Develop Deep Expertise

If this sounds like the kind of opportunity you're looking for, we'd love to hear from you.

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. All offers of employment are conditional on satisfactory evidence of the right to work in the UK being provided before employment starts.

Interviews will commence from the 1st of September.

title: Head of Cloud Platform Engineering
description:
Job Description:

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.

The Role

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.

Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.

The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).

  • Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.

  • Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.

  • Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.

  • Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.

  • Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.

  • Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.

  • Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.

  • Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.

  • Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.

  • Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.

  • Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.

  • Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.

  • Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).

  • Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).

  • Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.

  • Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.

  • Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.

General

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.

  • Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.

  • A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.

  • Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.

  • Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem.

  • Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering.

  • A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team.

  • A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves.

title: Hygienist - GA Mableton Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday
description:
JOB PURPOSE

Registered Dental Hygienists are assigned duties and responsibilities which involve licensed professional work providing dental hygiene services. A Registered Dental Hygienist (RDH) implements appropriate standard of care therapy, assists a dentist in providing hygiene, periodontal or dental care and treatment, provides dental hygiene assessments, creates treatment plans based on a dentist's diagnosis, and provides oral and overall health care education and instruction to patients.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

•Assess patients' teeth, bone, and periodontal tissues indicating the presence of any abnormalities or suspected diseases or conditions.

•Creates periodontal treatment plans based on the dentist's diagnosis.

•Bring to the immediate attention of the dentist any suspected lesion in the mouth or on the teeth.

•Thoroughly remove soft and hard deposits and extrinsic stain from teeth, using hand instruments, ultrasonic cavitron inserts, and prophy handpieces.

•Instruct patients on good oral hygiene practices, recommend appropriate products or devices for patients' home care, and provide other health care education, as necessary.

•Perform prophylaxis in the absence of periodontal disease or gingivitis.

•Perform full mouth debridement, either as a first stage gingivitis therapy or to remove interfering calculus to further enable a more accurate diagnosis and treatment plan.

•Perform scaling and root planing as a periodontal therapy.

•Place locally administered antibiotics as supportive periodontal therapy.

•Implement irrigation and desensitizing procedures or products as adjunctive to periodontal therapy.

•Position and expose dental and carpal radiographic film and sensors.

•Perform in-office whitening procedures, including first application of gel, curing the gel, and subsequent applications.

•Apply cavity-preventive agents, such as fluorides and pit and fissure sealants.

•Make recommendations as to patients' re-care interval and follow-up needs.

•All other duties and responsibilities as assigned and allowed under applicable Georgia state laws and regulations.

QUALIFICATIONS

•Must be licensed and in good standing with the state of Georgia.

•Associates or Bachelor's degree in dental hygiene.

•Current Basic Life Support (BLS) and cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) certificate.

•Must be willing to partner with the dentist and work well as a member of the total dental team. Should have visual acuity and manual dexterity, since they use dental instruments within a patient's mouth with little room for error.

WORKING CONDITIONS

An RDH works in clean, well-lit offices. Important health safeguards include, but are not limited to strict adherence to proper radiological procedures, infection control protocols, and the use of appropriate personal protective equipment when administering anesthetic gas, handling or using cleaning chemicals, or working in the dental laboratory.

An RDH must also wear appropriate personal protective equipment including, at minimum, safety glasses, surgical masks, full arm length gowns/lab coats, and gloves to protect themselves and patients from infectious diseases during all patient care and when handling contaminated instruments or equipment. Open-toe shoes are forbidden, long hair must be pulled back, and fingernails must be kept short and tidy.

title: Director of Finance
description:
About Camelback Ventures

Camelback Ventures transforms the landscape of entrepreneurship by investing in ventures and leaders who have been systematically excluded from capital and opportunity. We focus on entrepreneurs of color and women, providing not just funding but mentorship, advocacy, and access to the networks that drive meaningful change. Since 2015, Camelback has raised more than $75M and supported 220+ social entrepreneurs through our flagship Camelback Fellowship. Our Fellows have collectively raised more than $400M, earned recognition as Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, and created transformative impact in communities nationwide—from Eastern North Carolina to Seattle.

The Role

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Director of Finance to strategically develop, maintain, and oversee the systems that support the financial health and long-term sustainability of the organization. As a hands-on financial expert, you will lead budget development and tracking and continually strengthen our core financial systems—spend management, contract execution, and business planning and budgeting. In addition to supervising the Controller, this role plays a strong supporting role in fundraising and strategic planning.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Strategy & Planning

  • Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning, building the analyses and tools that model organizational cash flow, costs, and scenarios.

  • Partner with program and department leaders to support budget ownership, forecasting, and financial decision-making.

  • Prepare, analyze, and present accurate, timely financial reports—including monthly and annual financial statements, budget-to-actual analysis, cash flow plans, and dashboards.

  • Oversee CBV’s externally managed investment portfolio in accordance with the Board-approved investment policy, including coordinating with the investment advisor, monitoring performance, liquidity, fees, compliance, and expected withdrawals, and providing regular reporting to leadership, the Finance Committee, and the Board.

  • Communicate critical financial matters clearly to the CEO, Leadership Team, and Board Finance Committee, and equip leadership with reliable data for planning and decision-making.

  • Oversee the accounting and administration of SAFE agreements and other direct or mission-related investments, including maintaining complete records, monitoring conversion and liquidity events, reviewing valuation and accounting treatment, and coordinating with legal counsel, auditors, and program leadership as needed.

  • Identify revenue gaps and new program costs to inform fundraising strategy and priorities.

  • Support business development and earned-revenue strategies.

Accounting, Audit & Compliance

  • Oversee the monthly close and balance sheet reconciliation process, including ensuring all material accounts are reconciled timely, adequately supported, and independently reviewed.

  • Oversee semi-monthly payroll approval, including payroll changes, gross pay, benefit deductions, retirement contributions, payroll taxes, and related payroll journal entries.

  • Review and approve journal entries, restricted and conditional revenue, net asset releases, and related supporting schedules.

  • Make technical accounting decisions and provide final review of higher-risk areas.

  • Oversee accounting functions, including payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, grant tracking, and restricted-funding analysis.

  • Lead the annual audit; liaise with external auditors and the Board Finance Committee; oversee Form 990 preparation and other compliance requirements, including contracts, 1099s, and investment activity.

  • Establish, monitor, and strengthen internal controls, finance policies, and approval workflows to safeguard organizational assets.

  • Ensure compliance with tax laws and regulatory requirements.

  • Implement and maintain effective contract and financial management/reporting systems; ensure billing and collection schedules are met and that cash flow supports operational requirements.

  • Oversee banking, insurance, payment systems, contracts, state registrations, legal coordination, recurring compliance obligations, and key external finance partners.

  • Continuously strengthen finance policies, procedures, controls, and documentation to support compliance and sustainable growth without creating unnecessary complexity.

Grants & Contributed and Earned Revenue

  • Lead the financial tracking and management of all grants, including monitoring expenditures, analyzing financial data, and ensuring spending aligns with funder agreements and reporting requirements to ensure high quality stewardship.

  • Partner with the Chief Development Officer on multi-year revenue modeling and planning and scenario modeling.

  • Partner with Development to integrate fundraising pipeline projections, grant payment schedules, and cash flow forecasting into organizational planning.

  • In collaboration with the Controller, prepare project budgets for grant proposals and funding requests, and produce grant financial reports for major donors, corporations, and foundations.

  • Partner with Development and program leaders on grant budgets, restricted-funding compliance, donor reporting, and revenue forecasting.

  • Provide financial analysis to support institutional, corporate, and individual fundraising strategies.

  • Own and oversee Camelback’s fiscal sponsorship program, including program policies, due diligence, agreements, capacity and risk assessment, approval of disbursements, and financial and programmatic compliance throughout the sponsorship lifecycle.

Team Leadership & Supervision

  • Supervise and support the Controller in day-to-day finance operations, with an eye toward building the right long-term team structure.

  • Set clear goals, priorities, expectations, and accountability, and provide regular supervision, coaching, feedback, and performance support.

  • Help direct reports manage workload, deadlines, cross-functional responsibilities, and competing priorities, and support their professional development and role clarity.

  • Build a Finance team culture that is collaborative, organized, responsive, and grounded in service to the mission.

  • Ensure external vendors and consultants are well-managed, cost-effective, and aligned with organizational needs.

Requirements

The Person

You are a senior finance leader who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and ensuring the details get done. You bring calm, clarity, and structure to complex environments, and you understand that strong internal infrastructure is not separate from mission impact—it is what makes mission impact sustainable.

You are a trusted advisor to executive leadership and a practical partner to staff. You can move from Board-level financial strategy to workflow design, from audit oversight to systems to staff supervision, without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You lead with sound judgment, transparency, discretion, and care. You know how to build systems that are clear enough to support accountability and flexible enough to support people. You are energized by helping a mission-driven organization operate with greater focus, financial clarity, and internal alignment.

Experience & Expertise

  • Significant experience leading nonprofit finance.

  • Strong knowledge of nonprofit accounting, budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow planning, financial reporting, audits, Form 990, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.

  • Experience supporting executive leadership, Boards, and Board committees.

  • Experience supervising staff and managing external vendors, consultants, and professional service providers.

  • Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities across functions.

  • Experience building or improving systems, workflows, documentation, and internal controls.

  • Ability to communicate financial information clearly to non-finance audiences.

  • Working knowledge of payroll and benefits-related finance, and familiarity with HR and people-operations compliance.

  • Comfort working in a small, entrepreneurial nonprofit environment where leaders wear multiple hats and senior staff are closely engaged with execution, not just strategy.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in accounting, finance, or related field

  • Demonstrated proficiency with financial, payroll, benefits, and business operations systems, including QuickBooks Online, Airbase, Rippling, Employee Navigator, Fathom, and Google Workspace.

Preferred Experience

  • CPA or MBA preferred.

  • Experience overseeing nonprofit investment portfolios and working with external investment advisors, executive leadership, Boards, and Board committees.

  • Experience managing the accounting and administration of SAFE agreements or other direct venture investments.

  • Experience administering fiscal sponsorship programs and managing the related due diligence, agreements, disbursements, reporting, compliance, and ongoing sponsee relationships.

  • Experience with leadership transitions, organizational change, or scaling internal infrastructure.

  • Experience with remote or distributed teams.

  • Familiarity with tools such as QuickBooks Online, Airbase, Rippling, Employee Navigator, Fathom, and Google Workspace.

  • Experience in racial equity, education, entrepreneurship, philanthropy, or social impact organizations.

How You Work

  • A strategic thinker who turns big-picture priorities into clear plans, systems, and next steps.

  • A steady, trusted leader who handles confidential financial, personnel, and organizational matters with discretion.

  • A clear communicator who can translate complex finance topics into practical guidance.

  • A systems builder who documents processes, improves workflows, and creates structure without overcomplicating things.

  • A collaborative partner who works effectively across leadership, staff, Board members, and external vendors.

  • A hands-on leader who will roll up their sleeves when needed while still building capacity for the long term.

  • An equity-minded decision-maker who understands that policies, systems, and financial decisions shape organizational culture.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Budgets, forecasts, cash projections, financial reporting, and Board materials are accurate, timely, and provide clear insight for decision-making.

  • Finance systems, policies, procedures, internal controls, compliance processes and vendor oversight practices are well documented, consistently applied, and designed to support the organization as it grows and evolves.

  • The Controller has clear priorities, appropriate oversight, and the support needed to effectively manage day-to-day accounting operations.

  • Camelback navigates leadership transition and organizational change with greater clarity, coordination, and operational confidence.

Highlights

Schedule: Typical work hours 9am-5pm CST

title: Change & Release Coordinator
description:
Focus: Release Engineering, Automation & Environment Management (Prod & Non-Prod)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Change & Release Coordinator to manage, oversee, and optimize end-to-end change and release deployment processes across both production and non-production environments. You will bridge the gap between Development, DevOps, QA, and IT Operations to drive reliable, repeatable releases using automated deployment pipelines and strict governance framework protocols.

Key Responsibilities

Release Orchestration & Coordination

  • Own the Release Management Lifecycle for scheduled software releases, continuous integration builds, and hotfixes across multi-environment landscapes (Dev, Test, Staging, Prod).
  • Lead Release Readiness reviews, Go/No-Go checkpoints, Deployment Planning meetings, and post-implementation reviews (PIRs).
  • Coordinate deployment cutovers and dry runs across engineering, infrastructure, database, and security teams.

Change Governance & Compliance

  • Evaluate Change Requests (CRs) for risk, impact, environment dependencies, and technical readiness prior to CAB (Change Advisory Board) reviews.
  • Enforce compliance with organizational change policies, audit requirements, and ITIL standards across all changes.
  • Track change success/failure metrics, maintaining accurate release schedules and release documentation.

Automation & Environment Management

  • Collaborate with DevOps and Release Engineers to standardize automated deployment scripts, CI/CD pipelines, and environment configuration controls.
  • Drive transition strategies from manual deployment steps to fully automated pipeline deployments.
  • Manage environment access, code branch cutoffs, configuration drift monitoring, and synchronization between non-production and production environments.

Incident & Risk Mitigation

  • Establish standardized rollback protocols and contingency plans for high-risk changes.
  • Serve as the escalation point for deployment failures, environment contention issues, or pipeline blockages during release windows.

Qualifications & Key Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience in IT Change, Release, or Environment Management within cloud or hybrid enterprise landscapes.
  • Release Engineering & Automation: Knowledge and experience in working with team DevOps and automation work
  • ITSM & Governance: Deep working knowledge of ITSM frameworks and tools (ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, BMC Helix).
  • Environment Knowledge: Familiarity with managing code deployments across microservices, containers (Docker, Kubernetes), databases, and legacy platforms.
  • Methodologies: Strong understanding of Agile, DevSecOps, Continuous Delivery, and ITIL methodologies (ITIL Foundation certification preferred).
  • Communication: Excellent coordination, stakeholder management, and crisis control skills during critical deployment cutover windows.

description:

title: Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter (Remote - Canada, PT)
description:
This is a contract position open exclusively to candidates who are located in and legally authorized to provide services in Canada. Applications from candidates located outside of Canada will not be considered.

About Our Company

Kanopi Studios is a Design, Development & Support Agency with a fully distributed team of experts in Drupal & WordPress.

Our clients are mission-driven - and so are we. We design, build, and support websites that help their missions thrive.

We believe the people behind the work matter just as much as the work itself. That’s why we’re deeply committed to supporting our team’s growth, well-being, and success. When our people thrive, our clients do too - and together, we build a web that works better for everyone.

As Kanopi continues to grow, we're looking to engage a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter on a contract basis.

About The Job

Kanopi Studios is seeking a Contract Senior Website Content Strategist & Copywriter who can turn research and data into clear, effective website content experiences.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable developing content strategy and writing the final copy. They can take a project from discovery and research through strategy, content development and implementation. They should be able to clearly communicate and demonstrate the rationale behind their recommendations to internal and client teams.

Core Accountabilities

Champion User-Centered Content Strategy

  • Be a vocal advocate for user-first content practices within our internal and client teams.
  • Ensure content decisions are rooted in user research, accessibility best practices, and business goals.
  • Guide clients in understanding how content impacts navigation, usability, and conversions.

Craft Strategic, Accessible Copy

  • Write engaging copy that:
    • Aligns to the overall content strategy and project goals.
    • Meets established accessibility standards
    • Is SEO and AEO ready

Lead Content Discovery and Strategy

  • Plan, create, and present a range of deliverables including (but not limited to):
    • Content Audits & Map/Gap Analyses
    • User Journeys, Personas & User Flows
    • Keyword, SEO & AEO Research and Recommendations
    • Content Maps
    • Copy Guidelines, Voice/Tone Frameworks & UX Copywriting
    • Content governance documentation

Contribute to Kanopi's Brand and Sales Presence

  • Support the internal teams by contributing to thought leadership and promotional initiatives such as:
    • Being an active participant and voice for creative services in client pitch meetings
    • Webinars, case studies, and speaking engagements
    • Writing blog posts or participating in video content
    • Representing Kanopi at conferences or industry events

About the Compensation and Work Requirements

This is an independent contractor engagement. Work is project-based, hours will vary, and no minimum hours are guaranteed. Contractors invoice at their contracted hourly rate. The expected hourly rate range for this role is $50 - $70 CAD, depending on experience and skills. Please note the top of this range is firm and non-negotiable.

This is a 100% remote role. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada, reside in British Columbia, Alberta, Yukon, or the Northwest Territories, and be available for regular collaboration during Pacific Time business hours. We are not able to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Now, let’s talk about you!

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who have:

Must-Have Experience

  • 5+ years of combined content strategy and copywriting experience at a senior level, ideally within an agency or client services environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective content strategies based on qualitative research, and quantitative data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating engaging copy that meets SEO/AEO needs and conforms to established accessibility standards.
  • Experience working with remote and/or distributed teams.
  • Experience planning and structuring content for large or complex websites.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking, specifically in website content strategy (including content modelling, UX writing, and information architecture (IA) for digital experiences) and strong copywriting samples tied to specific project goals.

Tool Proficiency

  • User research & testing tools (e.g., Userbrain, Optimal Workshop)
  • Heatmap & behavior analytics (e.g., Mouseflow)
  • Analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console)
  • SEO & auditing platforms (e.g., SEMRush, Screaming Frog)
  • Google Workspace and other documentation tools

Skills & Qualities

  • Excellent writing and editing skills with impeccable grammar and attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate complex information into clear, accessible, and engaging content.
  • A strategic mindset with an eye for balancing business objectives with user needs.
  • Strong communication and facilitation skills, especially in client-facing contexts.
  • Solid understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive content practices (e.g., WCAG).
  • Comfortable juggling multiple projects and adapting quickly to shifting priorities.

What This Role Is Not

This role goes beyond copywriting and requires experience in content strategy. It is not focused on social media, marketing funnels, or ad campaigns. Instead, it centres on planning, structuring and maintaining website content to create clear, useful, accessible and consistent user experiences. The ideal candidate can solve complex content problems, shape content systems and work closely with design and implementation teams.

Studies show that some candidates, particularly women and people from underrepresented communities, only apply for a job when they meet every listed qualification. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't line up perfectly with every point above, we'd still love to hear from you.

Kanopi is committed to an inclusive team.

At Kanopi, we know that a diverse team makes us stronger, more creative, and more effective, and we enthusiastically welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

Kanopi Studios is committed to equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for engagement without regard to race, colour, national or ethnic origin, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, provincial, or territorial law.

  1. Use the ‘Apply for this Job’ button located toward the bottom of the page.
  2. Fill out all required fields on the Application page.
  3. Upload your resume.
  4. Upload your optional cover letter. Note: Some folks feel that cover letters are no longer important to hiring teams. Please be assured that Kanopi looks forward to reading yours! We’d love to hear what makes you a great fit for this role!
  5. Remember to include a link to your portfolio or work samples when prompted. If work is under NDA, redacted or anonymized materials are welcome.

What to expect after you apply:

We want to make sure we’re a great fit - for you and for us! Here’s what our process looks like:

Senior Business Analyst – Hospital ADT & Epic Prelude Migration

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst to support the functional analysis, feasibility assessment and migration planning of Hospital Admission, Discharge and Transfer (ADT) workflows as part of an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) transformation.

The consultant will assess the current hospital ADT processes, define the target workflows in Epic Prelude, identify functional and technical gaps, and develop a practical migration and cut-over strategy. Strong knowledge of the Belgian healthcare ecosystem is essential, particularly regarding regulatory requirements, patient identification, insurance eligibility and healthcare interoperability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead functional and business analysis of end-to-end ADT workflows across Emergency, Inpatient, Day Hospital and Outpatient services.
  • Facilitate workshops with admissions teams, billing departments, IT stakeholders and other business users.
  • Document current-state and target-state processes, business rules and functional requirements.
  • Assess Epic Prelude capabilities against Belgian healthcare requirements.
  • Perform detailed fit/gap and feasibility analyses and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Identify functional, technical and regulatory dependencies and risks.
  • Analyse critical workflows such as emergency admissions, patient identification, patient safety and census management.
  • Define business continuity measures for critical processes.
  • Assess required integrations with:
    • eID and ISI+ cards
    • National Registry services
    • MyCareNet and mutual insurance organizations
    • eHealth services and regional/national healthcare platforms
    • HL7, FHIR and API-based integrations
  • Collaborate with Epic specialists to assess Prelude/Grand Central capabilities and Belgian localization.
  • Develop a migration and cut-over strategy, including phasing, dual-run requirements, data conversion/remediation and critical-path dependencies.
  • Provide clear recommendations and executive-level summaries to project leadership.

Key Deliverables

  • Functional Analysis Dossier / Target Blueprint covering ADT processes and integration requirements.
  • Fit/Gap & Feasibility Matrix with identified gaps, risks and recommended solutions.
  • Migration & Rollout Plan covering implementation phases, dependencies, data migration, dual-run approach and cut-over strategy.
  • Documentation of key business processes, requirements, integrations and risks.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong experience as a Senior Business Analyst in healthcare IT.
  • Proven experience with hospital ADT processes and patient administration workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of the Belgian healthcare sector, including RIZIV/INAMI requirements and insurance eligibility processes.
  • Hands-on knowledge of MyCareNet, eHealth services, eID/ISI+ and healthcare interoperability.
  • Strong understanding of HL7 and FHIR and healthcare integration mechanisms.
  • Experience with EHR/EMR or Patient Administration System (PAS) implementations or migrations.
  • Experience performing business process analysis, business modelling and feasibility studies.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture and system integration.
  • Experience working with multiple business, clinical, technical and vendor stakeholders.
  • Excellent workshop facilitation, analytical and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and regulatory requirements into clear business solutions.

Desirable

  • Previous experience with Epic EMR.
  • Specific experience with Epic Prelude / Grand Central.
  • Familiarity with ZORGI OAZIS.
  • Experience with Belgian hospital system migrations or implementations.

Languages

  • English: Full professional proficiency
  • Dutch or French: Nice to have

Working Arrangement

  • Duration: 6–8 consecutive weeks
  • Location: Zaventem, Belgium
  • Hybrid: On-site presence required for workshops and steering meetings; remote work possible for analysis and documentation.

title: Sr. Director, Consumer Intelligence & Strategy​
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are the VMS Co-Op, a group of fast growing companies in the Vitamins, Minerals and Supplements (VMS) space. The VMS Co-Op includes OLLY, SmartyPants and future acquisitions to come! This position's home company is OLLY.​

THE ROLE: SENIOR DIRECTOR - CONSUMER INTELLIGENCE AND STRATEGY​

At OLLY and SmartyPants, we believe the best growth strategies start with a deep understanding of people. As Senior Director, Consumer Intelligence & Strategy, you will lead OLLY/SPV's Consumer Intelligence & Strategy function, setting the consumer and growth intelligence agenda and ensuring consumer understanding directly shapes growth choices, innovation priorities, and commercial decisions.​

This role sits at the center, partnering across Brand, Innovation, Sales, eCommerce, Finance, and Marketing to ensure our most important decisions are rooted in consumer understanding and actionable intelligence. You will lead a team responsible for consumer insights, analytics, foresight, AI-enabled intelligence capabilities, and performance measurement while also connecting growth analytics, commercial intelligence, and enterprise decision support into a more integrated view of where the business should focus. This leader will connect consumer understanding, growth analytics, commercial and retail intelligence, foresight, and AI-enabled systems into an integrated enterprise capability that helps OLLY/SPV make smarter growth decisions, prioritize investments, and stay ahead of emerging consumer and market shifts.​

More than a traditional insights leader, you are a strategic business partner who translates consumer, shopper, cultural, commercial, and business intelligence into growth strategies, innovation priorities, investment decisions, and enterprise learning. You do not simply respond to questions from the business

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:​

Consumer Intelligence & Strategy Leadership​

  • Define and lead OLLY/SPV consumer intelligence strategy and multi-year enterprise intelligence agenda.​
  • Serve as the voice and champion of the consumer across the organizations, ensuring decisions are grounded in consumer understanding and market reality.​
  • Translate consumer, shopper, cultural, commercial, and business intelligence into actionable recommendations that shape brand strategy, innovation priorities, campaign development, investment decisions, and growth outcomes.​
  • Partner closely with the leadership teams to identify strategic opportunities, risks, and future growth platforms, influencing organizational strategies, and long-term growth priorities.​

Growth, Brand & Innovation Strategy​

  • Guide the development of brand, innovation, and commercial strategies through deep consumer understanding and foresight.​
  • Identify emerging consumer needs, cultural shifts, category trends, and whitespace opportunities that can fuel future growth.​
  • Lead strategic synthesis across consumer research, analytics, trend intelligence, and business performance to shape long-term priorities.​
  • Support innovation pipeline development by identifying unmet needs, opportunity territories, and the consumer problems most worth solving.​

Analytics & Business Performance​

  • Ensure robust measurement frameworks are in place across marketing, innovation, retail, and commercial initiatives.​
  • Guide analytics-driven decision making across brand, shopper, eCommerce, and commercial performance.​
  • Oversee learning agendas related to marketing effectiveness, consumer behavior, growth drivers, and business performance.​
  • Partner with Sales, Category Management, RGM, eCommerce and Finance to translate consumer behavior, category dynamics, and commercial performance into growth plans that carry through to retail execution.​

AI, Intelligence Systems & Future Capabilities​

  • Lead the transformation of OLLY/SPV into an AI-first intelligence organization, redefining how consumer, shopper, cultural, and commercial signals are generated, synthesized, shared, and activated.​
  • Build and scale AI-enabled capabilities that help the business identify emerging opportunities, anticipate market shifts, and make faster, smarter growth decisions.​
  • Reimagine traditional insights, analytics, and research approaches through AI-enabled research, predictive intelligence, signal detection, automated synthesis, and scalable knowledge systems.​
  • Establish the tools, systems, and ways of working that increase learning velocity, reduce duplication, and make intelligence easier to access and apply across the business.​
  • Continuously pilot emerging technologies and methodologies that create competitive advantage and future-proof howOLLY/SPV understands consumers and markets.​

Build OLLY/SPV's enterprise learning advantage.​

  • Understand today's consumer​
  • Anticipate tomorrow's consumer​
  • Quantify growth opportunities​
  • Accelerate learning velocity​
  • Enable smarter decisions​
  • Scale intelligence through AI and modern capabilities​

Team Leadership​

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team across consumer insights, analytics, foresight, and intelligence capabilities.​
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, strategic thinking, experimentation, and continuous learning.​
  • Establish clear priorities, coach talent, and build capabilities that elevate the impact of the function.​
  • Create strong alignment and collaboration across OLLY and SPV insights resources, ensuring the function operates with clear priorities and consistent enterprise impact.​

THE CANDIDATE​

You are a highly strategic, consumer and growth-obsessed leader who thrives at the intersection of insights, analytics, strategy, and business growth. You possess an unusual ability to connect seemingly disparate signals, identify emerging opportunities, and synthesize complexity into clear recommendations that influence enterprise decisions.​

You are equally comfortable discussing consumer motivations, innovation platforms, commercial performance, marketing effectiveness, future trends, and AI-enabled capabilities. You understand that insights alone are not enough. The real value comes from transforming intelligence into action.​

You are known for asking the right questions, uncovering opportunities others miss, and helping organizations make smarter decisions faster. You bring a clear point of view, challenge assumptions constructively, and help senior leaders make sharper choices.​

CAPABILITIES + SKILLS REQUIRED​

Strategic Leadership & Influence

  • 15+ years of progressive experience across consumer insights, strategy, analytics, innovation, consulting, marketing, or related disciplines.​
  • Strong business acumen, senior stakeholder partnership, and ability to build alignment and drive action.​
  • Ability to translate consumer understanding into strategic priorities and business outcomes.​
  • Proven ability to define and lead a consumer intelligence strategy and multi-year enterprise intelligence agenda.​

​Consumer, Commercial & Growth Expertise​

  • Deep expertise in consumer insights, shopper behavior, market dynamics, and growth strategy.​
  • Ability to connect consumer trends, category opportunities, and commercial realities to identify future growth opportunities.​
  • Demonstrated success turning insights into actionable recommendations that shape brand, innovation, and business strategy.​

​Analytics, AI & Future-Focused Thinking​

  • Strong analytical capabilities across multiple data sources, measurement frameworks, and business performance diagnostics.​
  • Ability to synthesize consumer, cultural, technological, and business signals into actionable foresight.​
  • AI-first mindset: proven track record leading the transformation of an insights or analytics function into an AI-enabled intelligence organization, redefining how consumer, shopper, cultural, and commercial signals are generated, synthesized, and activated to increase learning velocity and speed enterprise decisions.​
  • Appetite to continuously pilot emerging technologies and challenge traditional research methods to create competitive advantage.

Leadership Style

  • Proven ability to lead high-performing teams and influence enterprise-level decisions.​
  • Exceptional communicator and storyteller capable of simplifying complexity for senior audiences.​
  • Highly collaborative and influential across diverse stakeholders.​
  • Strategic, curious, growth-oriented, and outcomes-oriented.​
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity while bringing clarity and focus to decisions.​
  • Able to proactively surface opportunities, risks, and recommendations that help leaders make better decisions faster.​​

WHAT TO EXPECT DURING THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Initial video screen with a member of our Talent team
  • Round 1: Conversation with the Hiring Manager + 1-2 conversations with other Ollies on the team
  • Round 2: 2-3 conversations with team or cross functional Ollies
  • Final Round: Homework*

*At OLLY, our final round is called Homework. Candidates who participate in this round are given 3 questions in advance to answer and present to the interview panel they previously spoke with in the process. We understand every candidate is different. If you need a reasonable accommodation to adjust this procedure, please let us know as soon as possible so that we can evaluate and provide other options that work for your needs

THE DETAILS

​LOCATION: Remote, USA - 4X travel per year to company offsites​

HOURS: Full time, exempt (salary)​

PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

The base pay range for this position is $209,340 - 255,860.00. For this remote role, compensation is determined based on geographic location and experience, and the final offer will reflect these factors within the posted range.

WHAT WE OFFER:

  • An opportunity to work with an intelligent, inspiring, and extraordinarily fun team
  • We pay 100% of the premiums for employee-only medical, dental + orthodontics, and vision insurance
  • 4 weeks PTO + paid holidays + 12 Mental Health Days per year
  • 100% Paid parental leave, Fertility + Adoption Benefits
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) plan with Employer Match
  • Hybrid Work + Wellness + Cell Phone Stipends
  • Free product
  • And much more!

title: Tire Kingdom - Automotive Mechanics
description:
Tire Kingdom & Mavis Tires & Brakes at Discount Prices - Automotive Mechanics


Tire Kingdom is proud to join the Mavis Tire family. We're looking for full-time Automotive Mechanics to join Team Mavis at one of our state-of-the-art automotive service and retail tire sales centers in the Brandon, FL area. With over 2,000 retail locations, Mavis is one of the largest tire sales and automotive repair chains in the United States.

About the Position of Automotive Mechanic

As Mavis's leaders in undercar repairs, our Automotive Mechanics are trusted to inspect, diagnose, and perform a wide variety of automotive services on customers' vehicles. Mavis's Automotive Mechanics perform a wide variety of undercar repairs, including brakes, struts and shocks. Automotive Mechanics are also responsible for completing state-mandated inspections, changing oil and filters, checking fluids, replacing worn parts, and dismounting, mounting, rotating and balancing tires.

Employee Benefits

At Mavis, we understand that our people drive our success. We provide our team members with competitive weekly pay, including weekly incentive compensation, a good working environment and an excellent combination of additional benefits like health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match, paid vacations, paid time off, paid holidays, life insurance, on-the-job training, and opportunities for career growth and advancement.

Qualifications

We recruit team members who share our commitment to providing complete customer satisfaction and delivering the highest quality service. To be eligible for the position of Automotive Mechanic, you must (1) be at least 18 years of age; (2) be legally authorized to work in the United States; (3) possess 2 years of experience and/or training in automotive repair and maintenance or any combination of education, training and experience which demonstrates the ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the position; and (4) possess an extensive tool box of personal tools used in performing undercar repairs.

The following additional qualifications are preferred: (1) state inspection license(s); and, (2) ASE Certifications in Automotive Maintenance and Light Repair (G1), Suspension and Steering (A4), and Brakes (A5).

As an active position, Automotive mechanics are required to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, crouch, crawl, climb, pull, reach and perform repeated and repetitive movements consistent with vehicle maintenance and automotive repair. Mechanics must regularly lift and/or move items weighing over 50 pounds.

title: Senior Databricks Data Engineer – Data Platform & Medallion Architecture 3657895 (Richmond, VA)
description:
Be Part Of A High-Performing Team

Join a data engineering organization that is modernizing enterprise data capabilities and building scalable solutions to improve how critical business information is ingested, standardized, governed, and consumed. The team is expanding its use of Databricks to create reusable engineering frameworks, modern data models, observability capabilities, and advanced analytics solutions.

This role will work closely with architects, technical leads, business partners, and distributed engineering teams while contributing directly to new Databricks capabilities. Projects include data pipeline modernization, medallion architecture, underwriting-data analytics, data-quality frameworks, and emerging AI-enabled capabilities such as intelligent document processing.

What's In Store For You

  • Engagement: W2 only (no C2C/1099)
  • Work model: Fully remote within the U.S., working Eastern Time hours
  • Preference for candidates located in or near Richmond, Virginia
  • Contract-to-hire opportunity
  • Opportunity to help define reusable Databricks engineering standards and frameworks used across multiple teams
  • Exposure to newer Databricks capabilities, including AI-assisted development and intelligent document processing
  • Broad ownership across requirements, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support

How You Will Make An Impact

  • Design, develop, and enhance enterprise-scale data solutions using Databricks and medallion architecture.
  • Build reusable frameworks and common functions that standardize data ingestion, transformation, validation, repair, and pipeline monitoring.
  • Develop Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers that improve the usability, consistency, and accessibility of enterprise data.
  • Create dimensional data structures, including facts, dimensions, derived attributes, and SCD Type 2 implementations.
  • Develop and orchestrate both batch and streaming data pipelines.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate high-level data requirements into technical solutions.
  • Collaborate with architects and technical leadership on solution design and engineering standards.
  • Perform hands-on development, unit testing, system integration testing, debugging, and production support.
  • Build solutions that improve pipeline observability, SLA monitoring, data quality, and operational transparency.
  • Optimize Databricks compute and storage performance.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and reusable guidance so other engineering teams can adopt frameworks and capabilities.
  • Explore newer Databricks functionality such as Intelligent Document Processing, Genie, and self-service workspace capabilities and establish practical implementation patterns.

Do You Have the Expertise to Lead in Databricks Data Engineering?

  • Minimum 3 years of full-time, hands-on Databricks experience within Azure or AWS environments.
  • Strong experience implementing the medallion architecture, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
  • Expert-level SQL skills.
  • Intermediate or stronger PySpark programming experience.
  • Demonstrated experience creating reusable data engineering frameworks, common functions, or standardized pipeline components.
  • Hands-on experience creating dimensional models, fact tables, dimensions, derived business values, and SCD Type 2 structures.
  • Strong Databricks orchestration experience supporting batch and streaming pipelines.
  • Experience with Databricks capabilities such as Unity Catalog, Spark UI, job scheduling, Lakeflow, and data quality expectations.
  • Proven experience with unit testing, SIT, UAT support, debugging, and troubleshooting data defects.
  • Experience optimizing Databricks compute and storage.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, Git-based development, and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience working within Agile environments, including user stories, technical task definition, and effort estimation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business users, architects, engineering teams, and onshore/offshore partners.
  • Strong problem-solving, design-thinking, teamwork, and documentation skills.
  • Candidates with 5+ years of Databricks experience and experience building major platform capabilities from scratch are strongly preferred.
  • Insurance data, data governance, or data observability experience is beneficial.

title: Investor Relations
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Investor Relations Associate/Manager — $1B+ AUM Venture Capital Fund

Location: New York, NY (In-Office; SF secondary office)
Compensation: $150,000–$300,000 base (OTE $180,000–$360,000) + carry and performance-based economics
Headcount: 1–3 openings
Visa Sponsorship: Available (OPT, H1B transfer support)

About the Firm

Our client is an early-to-late-stage venture capital fund with $1B+ in assets under management, backing 30+ category-defining companies across AI, infrastructure, robotics, energy, space tech, and life sciences. Founded in 2015, the firm combines deep venture expertise with an extraordinary network of founder and Fortune 500 relationships. This is a lean, 20-person team where individual contributors carry real ownership over outcomes.

The Opportunity

This is a rare seat at an elite fund with a portfolio most investors would envy. You'll own institutional LP relationships end-to-end — not administer them — while getting hands-on exposure to multi-hundred-million-dollar SPV structuring and a real path toward an investment role.   • Degree from a top-tier institution (Ivy League, Stanford, MIT, Northwestern, or similar)
  • Prior experience at a recognized VC (e.g., Base10, Headline, SignalFire, General Catalyst, Sequoia, Benchmark), PE firm (e.g., Blackstone, Apollo, Carlyle, KKR), or bulge-bracket bank (Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan)
  • Demonstrated ownership of institutional LP relationships — not just supporting materials or CRM upkeep
  • Experience structuring or supporting multi-million/billion-dollar co-investment vehicles
  • Strong financial modeling skills: fund performance, LP returns, carry structures, investment economics
  • Executive presence and the ability to present to sophisticated institutional audiences
  • Entrepreneurial, detail-oriented, and comfortable in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment
  • Must be based in or willing to relocate to New York; this is an in-office role

title: Operations Lead (Maternity Cover)
description:

title: Manufacturing & Facilities Technician
description:
Join CV Technology’s Manufacturing team and help build the products and systems behind our mission to make the world a safer place.

We are looking for a hands-on, mechanically inclined individual who enjoys variety, takes pride in their work, and isn’t afraid to jump in where needed. This role combines mechanical assembly and production work with material handling, shipping support, and light facility maintenance.

You don’t need to know everything on Day 1. We’re looking for someone who can follow instructions, work safely, learn new processes, and take ownership of getting the job done right.

What Does a Manufacturing & Facilities Technician Do?

This is an on-site position at our Jupiter, FL headquarters supporting the day-to-day needs of our Manufacturing operation.

A typical day may involve assembling or reworking production components, preparing materials for shipment, moving products or materials throughout the facility, completing required documentation, or handling a routine facility maintenance task.

  • Performs a wide range of skilled repetitive mechanical assembly operations in support of production projects.
  • Assembles, modifies, reworks, and/or reassembles production components utilizing drawings, pick tickets, process documentation, and/or verbal instructions.
  • Prepares and utilizes basic hand tools and machines including but not limited to power screwdriver, ruler, solder iron, clamp machine, heat gun, vise, solder pot, crimpers, pinning machine, and automatic wire strippers.
  • Identifies wires with use of basic color code sequence.
  • Possesses and maintains thorough knowledge of all applicable safety regulations and considerations.
  • Completes all required paperwork; prepares required reports and correspondence.
  • Places merchandise in a warehouse or storage facility by packaging, lifting items as necessary, operating forklifts and pallet jacks for large goods
  • Inspects shipping containers to ensure they meet shipping regulations.
  • Assembles daily orders by shipping location or any other shipping categories
  • Assist with light facility maintenance, including HVAC filter changes, basic plumbing needs, replacing bulbs, and minor repairs
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment
  • Follow applicable safety requirements and safe work practices at all times

What to Expect Physically
This is an active, hands-on role in a manufacturing and warehouse environment. Team members should be comfortable:
  • Standing frequently throughout the workday
  • Lifting, pushing, and carrying items weighing up to 50 pounds
  • Occasionally climbing, balancing, bending, stooping, kneeling, or crawling
  • Working around moving mechanical equipment, machinery, and vehicles
  • Wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE) based on the task being performed
  • Previous experience operating a forklift
  • Previous experience driving a box truck
  • Experience with basic facility maintenance or general hands-on repair work
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and manual dexterity
  • Ability to safely and effectively use hand and power tools
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions, safety requirements, and assembly drawings
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing quality work
  • Ability to organize and prioritize work as needs change
  • Willingness to learn and take on a variety of responsibilities
  • Ability to work independently from written or verbal instructions

Forklift certification is preferred but not required.

CRA II - Sponsor Dedicated - West Coast.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
