title: Operations Team leader with Freight forwarding background
description:
Make a key difference for sustainability with your operational transport insight!

In Combineering you can make a true difference. Both for the environment and for a small team of dedicated employees, who daily send various types of waste to safer handling, reuse or conversion into energy. Across borders. Across industries. Handling both the routine transports and the new startup routes. In a heavily regulated complex transport niche.

You will be working closely with both Sales, Finance, Legal & Compliance, your team itself and your team leader colleague. Delivering customer service and profitability. While optimising the supply chain, following our ISO requirements, making sure invoices are issued and paid. You will be end-to-end contributions responsible.

Your role will be partly hands on logistics solutions, but also to a large degree coordinating, reporting, developing, purchasing transport and problem solving. A great career step for an experienced freight forwarding team leader, who wants to switch from the seller to the buyer position.
You will act as the operational lead for the team and support the development of employees, processes, and customer satisfaction while working closely with the COO and other stakeholders. You will have full departmental contribution margin responsibility and will contribute to operational performance, forecasting, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in the monthly closure process, budgeting process and in the development of the full operational function and department in general too. All in all: So many exciting tasks, growth possibilities and ways to add your fingerprint to the business development. While still being able to utilize your operational knowledge in your everyday life.

Come and work for the environment…

We are passionate about resource recovery, recycling, and environmental legislation. We convert waste and residues from both public and private companies into new raw materials – creating a better future while building meaningful partnerships.

As Combineering is part of the British Reconomy Group with more than 4,500 employees serving customers in over 150 countries, you will experience the best of both worlds. A smaller agile company with short lines of command and swift decision-making processes, plus the benefits of being part of a large international company with established procedures and structured project frameworks.
In a supportive job environment:

When joining us, you can look forward to having a high degree of responsibility in shaping and coordinating the operational setup. You, and your team 3-5 members, will be working closely with employees in every department of the company, and will be the ones turning R&D + Sales brilliant ideas and committing partnerships into real-life transports. You will be joining a little green work family and experience a collaborative, informal and international atmosphere. We value teamwork, transparency, dedication, proactiveness and a focus on growing and developing together. We have plenty of room and respect for diversity and will give you ample opportunities to grow both professionally and personally.
You combine solid logistical experience and dedication with a clear customer focus, a positive energy, sound problem-solving skills, and a hands-on operational mindset. You enjoy working in a dynamic setup where no two days look the same – and where coordination, communication and structure are key to success.

So, to put it into bullets, we would like for you to have:

an Education
  • especially as an educated Freight Forwarder or equivalent logistics background as a prerequisite
  • Degree in Business or Supply Chain Management is an advantage
  • Waste industry education is an advantage
lots of Experience
  • Experience leading or coordinating operational teams
  • Logistics and freight forwarding experience
  • Customer-facing experience
  • Transport (Road/Trucking) negotiation and planning is an advantage
  • Experience from the waste or recycling industry is an advantage
these Skills
  • Danish and English – spoken and written to perfection
  • Fluency in either German or Italian is a clear advantage
  • Strong customer service mindset
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive and problem-solving mindset
  • Structured and detail-oriented
  • Strong understanding of compliance and operational processes
...and with all this we would like to see
  • High customer satisfaction
  • Fast resolution of operational issues and claims
  • Accurate forecasting and reporting
  • Efficient and smooth project implementations
  • Operational excellence and continuous improvement
  • Strong team engagement and collaboration
  • Ensuring backup solutions for critical transport activities
Does this sound like an opportunity tailormade for you?

Then join us in Combineering, a growing international greentech company dedicated to recycling, circular economy and resource recovery. Here you'll find development opportunities, independent responsibility, and truly wonderful colleagues. We will provide you with an attractive compensation package, a huge sense of meaningfulness in your job, and a perfect balance of individual responsibility and international teamwork.

If you’re curious to know more about the job, you are welcome to contact COO Henrik Mørch at Henrik.morch@combineering.dk. Full job description available upon request.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV via LinkedIn as soon as possible.

We are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion within our organization. Therefore, we welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, ethnicities, and backgrounds.

Learn more about us at: combineering.dk

title: Senior Lead Release Train Engineer (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

The Senior Lead Release Train Engineer (Sr. RTE) is an experienced servant leader, enterprise coach, and execution partner for a highly complex Agile Release Train or multiple closely aligned trains within Lumen’s Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). You will be responsible for driving ART maturity, improving flow, coaching leaders and teams, and ensuring complex delivery commitments are translated into executable plans.

The Senior Lead RTE is expected to operate with greater independence, judgment, and cross-functional influence. This role supports more complex value delivery environments, mentors RTEs and Scrum Masters, strengthens operating standards. You will partner closely with Product Management, Product Owners, System Architects, Scrum Masters, STEs, TPMs, Engineering leaders, and stakeholders to ensure the ART executes as one coordinated delivery system.

Location

This a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Advanced ART Planning & Execution: Lead PI Planning readiness, PI Planning, ART Sync, Scrum of Scrums, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt, and related operating-cadence ceremonies for a complex ART or multiple closely aligned ARTs.
  • Advanced Cross-Team Alignment: Lead planning and alignment across complex teams, related ARTs, and senior stakeholders; ensure scope, capacity, dependencies, and tradeoffs are visible before commitments are made.
  • Coaching & Role Clarity: Coach Product Management, Product Owners, Scrum Masters, TPMs, Engineering leaders, Architects, and Business Owners on Lean-Agile practices, role clarity, flow, escalation discipline, and decision-making.
  • Systemic Risk, Dependency & Impediment Management: Identify, track, manage, and escalate systemic risks, cross-ART dependencies, capacity constraints, organizational impediments, and execution-pattern issues before they threaten delivery commitments.
  • Advanced Metrics, Flow & Operating Standards: Define, improve, and govern ART-level metrics, dashboards, flow insights, maturity assessments, reusable playbooks, and operating standards that improve delivery transparency and predictability.
  • Relentless Improvement & ART Maturity: Drive continuous improvement across teams and leadership forums by ensuring improvement actions become owned, visible, prioritized, measurable, and embedded into future planning cycles.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of experience in technical program management, Agile delivery leadership, SDLC operations, product delivery, systems delivery, or related technology execution roles.
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience facilitating or leading Agile Release Train execution, PI Planning, ART Sync, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt, and ART-level delivery governance.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach leaders, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, Product Managers, TPMs, Architects, and engineering teams in Lean-Agile behaviors and scaled execution practices.
  • Proven ability to manage complex risks, dependencies, impediments, and organizational constraints across multiple teams or related ARTs.
  • Tooling & Reporting: Experience with Jira, Jira Align, Confluence, Agile dashboards, flow metrics, dependency tracking, and executive-ready delivery reporting preferred.
  • Experience building metrics, dashboards, playbooks, reporting routines, and improvement systems that increase delivery transparency and predictability.
  • SAFe / Agile Certification: SAFe RTE strongly preferred; SPC, SAFe Agilist, SAFe Scrum Master, CSM, CSPO, or equivalent experience also valued.

title: Full Stack Developer – TypeScript / Node.js / React
description:

Join our team!

We’re looking for a Full-Stack Developer to join our 100% remote team. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys taking ownership, and wants to help shape a product from the ground up.

  • Implement and maintain unit/integration test suites (Vitest / Jest / React Testing Library)
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates (linting, type‑checking, builds, and tests) via GitHub Actions

  • Experience writing and maintaining unit/integration tests (Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library)
  • Working knowledge of GitHub Actions or equivalent CI/CD systems, with focus on automation, coverage thresholds, and dependency security scanning
  • Comfortable working with Docker and multi‑service local environments
  • Familiarity with AWS or GCP cloud platforms, especially messaging, storage, and logging services
  • Demonstrated ability to balance rapid delivery with clean, maintainable, and testable code

Nice to have:

Other/Soft Skills:

  • You must have full‑time availability
  • You must be a Team Player
  • You should speak/write English at a professional level
  • You should be keen on doing video calls

  1. Our team will carefully review your application, and if your experience and qualifications match our needs, we’ll invite you for an initial call
  2. Technical Assignment on TestGorilla

  4. Call with Client

title: Director of Academic Operations
description:
Bethel University
Adult, Graduate, & Extension Studies


Job Title: Director of Academic Operations
Department: AGS
Location: Adult and Graduate Suite
Reports To: Dean of BU-X and Online Learning
Prepared On: 8/12/2026
Position Type: Full-Time (non-exempt)/40 hours per week


Position Summary

The Director of Academic Operations for Online Programs supports the daily academic and administrative operations of the online division and serves as a key operational partner to the Dean. This position ensures that academic scheduling, registrar processes, adjunct contracting, onboarding, course readiness, and departmental workflows are completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with institutional expectations.


The Director exercises sound independent judgment in routine decision-making, manages operational projects for the team, and keeps the Dean informed of significant issues, risks, and recommendations. The role also supervises student workers and graduate assistants and works collaboratively with internal partners to support high-quality online academic operations.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Academic Scheduling and Course Operations

  • Direct and maintain the online academic schedule in collaboration with the Dean, program coordinators, academic departments, the department, and the Registrar.
  • Oversee course updates, instructor assignments, section changes, and enrollment adjustments to ensure course readiness for each session.

title: Senior Director Data & Analytics
description:
The mission of the Senior Director, Data & Analytics is to build the data foundation and analytical engine that powers every major decision at Curology — from how we acquire and retain patients to how we deliver personalized, science-backed care at scale. Reporting to [TBD] (with the reporting structure expected to evolve as the organization continues to grow), this role owns Curology's data infrastructure, architecture, and customer data platform, and leads a team spanning analytics, experimentation, and data science to turn subscriber and clinical data into decisions the business can act on.

Success in this role means using peripheral vision to connect data strategy to broader business outcomes across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Clinical, and Finance, and translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous, testable models. The Senior Director thinks in systems, governance, experimentation, and enterprise decision-making — balancing an ambitious data roadmap with sound judgment about what the business actually needs to trust and act on.

Essential Functions and Impact Areas

Data Strategy & Architecture

  • Define and execute the enterprise data strategy for Curology, aligning insights and models with enterprise-wide goals in growth, retention, patient care, and profitability.
  • Own and evolve the data stack, including pipelines, tooling, and architecture, ensuring reliability, scalability, and accessibility.
  • Guide the design and implementation of scalable data infrastructure in collaboration with Engineering to prioritize performance, advanced analytics, and security.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure scalable, secure, and accessible data infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and self-serve needs.

Customer Data Platform & Personalization

  • Lead ongoing development and governance of the customer data platform, aligning platform capabilities with personalization, compliance, and marketing needs.
  • Develop predictive and prescriptive models that support lifecycle marketing, personalization, retention optimization, and LTV forecasting.

Team Leadership & Culture

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of analysts and data scientists, fostering a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a thought leader and culture carrier, promoting data fluency and analytical thinking across all levels of the company.

Experimentation & Decision Support

  • Advance experimentation capabilities by formalizing test-and-learn methodologies and driving rigor in experiment design, execution, and analysis.
  • Establish executive dashboards and KPI frameworks that provide visibility into business health and performance across key domains.
  • Understand and evaluate AI-generated data, ensuring model outputs are interpretable, accurate, and actionable for business decision-making across product, marketing, and patient experience.

Governance, Compliance & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Own efforts for data quality, governance, and PII compliance in coordination with Legal and Engineering to ensure integrity in both day-to-day decisions and long-term modeling.
  • Partner closely with executive leadership, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Operations to identify high-leverage opportunities and deliver analytics that inform strategic decisions.
  • Stay current on analytics innovation, AI/ML advancements, and industry benchmarks to evaluate tools and techniques that elevate our capabilities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 12-15 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or data science, with at least 5 years in people leadership roles.
  • Deep experience in a high-growth, consumer-facing technology environment (DTC, ecommerce, healthtech, or subscription business preferred).
  • Proven ownership of modern data stack, including pipelines, orchestration, and data warehouse platforms (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Mastery of modern analytics tools and programming languages (e.g., SQL, Python, dbt, Looker, Tableau).
  • Strong grasp of experimental design, cohort analysis, predictive modeling, attribution methodologies, and growth diagnostics.
  • Proven ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, comfortable building executive narratives and jumping into datasets when needed.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to translate complexity into clarity for non-technical audiences.
  • High integrity, low ego, and a builder's mindset. You are focused on what drives results for the business and the team.
  • Working familiarity with AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and demonstrated strong judgment applying them to analytics work such as modeling, reporting, and executive narratives, with accountability for reviewing and validating outputs before use.

Benefits

Location

Remote (US)

Benefits & Perks

  • 💰 Competitive compensation and equity package (RSUs)
  • 🥼 Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, FSA and HSA, supplemental coverages (critical illness, accident, hospitalization), and 401(k)
  • 🧘🏻‍♀️ Access to wellbeing perks, including OneMedical, Spring Health, SoFi, and Employee Assistance Program
  • 🌴 Flexible paid time off and holiday policy
  • 🐣 Paid parental leave (birthing and non-birthing parents)
  • 💜 Employee donation matching program
  • 🫱🏻‍🫲🏽 Culture Committee and employee resource groups for virtual and in-person connectivity
  • ✨ Complimentary VIP Subscription to Curology or Agency, plus online retail discount

The estimated base salary range for this role is $220,000-$240,000 per year, plus a competitive equity package and benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including location, skills, experience, and job-related expertise.

Our Typical Interview Process*

*Subject to change based on role

  • 30 minute Recruiter screen (phone)
  • 30-45 minute interview with a Hiring Manager (Google Meet or Zoom)
  • 30-45 minute technical assessment, case study, or peer interview(s) (Google Meet or Zoom)
  • 30-45 minute final round interview with Hiring Manager or Team Leader (Google Meet or Zoom)

At Curology, we invest in responsible use of AI tools to help our teams innovate and solve challenges. Please feel free to use AI to:

title: Head of Education
description:
At ELEMIS, we believe exceptional customer experiences begin with exceptional education.

As Head of Education, you'll lead the delivery of our education strategy across Retail, Spa and International markets, ensuring learning inspires confidence, builds capability and delivers measurable commercial impact.

This is a leadership role that goes beyond delivering education. You'll shape how we develop our people, partner with the business to drive performance and lead an integrated Education function comprising our field-based Spa & Retail Training team and Content Designers, ensuring the expertise that creates our learning works hand-in-hand with the people who bring it to life.

Working closely with the Global Director of Education and senior stakeholders across Commercial, Retail, Spa, Marketing and Product, you'll ensure Education remains at the heart of the customer journey and continues to evolve alongside the needs of our business.

This role is based in the London offices/or field for a minimum of three days per week, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders and the wider Education team. Regular travel across the UK and Ireland is required to support Retail stores, Spa partners and business priorities, together with occasional international travel for conferences, distributor support and strategic Education initiatives.
Lead the Education Strategy
  • Translate our global education vision into meaningful learning experiences that support our people, partners and customers across the UK, Ireland and International markets.
  • Working closely with the Global Director of Education, you'll ensure Education remains commercially relevant, globally consistent and aligned with the evolving needs of the business.
  • Champion an education strategy built around three core pillars: Treatment Excellence, Product Expertise, Commercial Excellence

Inspire One High-Performing Education Team

  • Lead, coach and inspire an integrated Education team, bringing together our field-based Spa & Retail Trainers and Content Designers to create one connected approach to learning and capability across ELEMIS.
  • Offer direction to the Content Designers, ensuring their priorities are closely aligned to the Education strategy, commercial priorities and the needs of our Retail, Spa and International markets.
  • Drive the connection between what we create, what our trainers deliver and what our colleagues and partners need to perform at their best.
  • Collect feedback and insight from the field to help shape future content, while our Content Designers will ensure trainers have engaging, consistent and commercially relevant tools to bring learning to life.
  • Prioritise team member development by ensuring every member of the Education team has clear objectives, meaningful development opportunities and the coaching and support they need to be successful.
  • Oversee the deployment of the field Education team, ensuring trainer schedules, regional coverage, business priorities and major events are effectively planned so Education resource is always focused where it delivers the greatest value.
  • Build capability across the wider Education team, including external commercial sales training and the ELEMIS Spa education programme where required, ensuring the team continues to broaden its capability and expertise.

Drive Commercial Performance Through Education

  • Partner with the Commercial Director, Retail Leadership Team, Area Managers and Spa Business Partners to ensure learning is directly linked to business priorities.
  • Deliver education to strengthen consultation skills, improve conversion, increase retail performance and help our teams confidently maximise every customer interaction.
  • Success will be measured not only through learning engagement but through improved commercial performance, customer experience and business results.

Build Strong Business Partnerships
  • Become a trusted partner across the business, working collaboratively with Retail, Spa, Marketing, Product Development and our International distributors.
  • By building strong relationships and understanding business priorities, you'll ensure Education remains agile, relevant and capable of supporting product launches, commercial initiatives, events and long-term strategic growth.

Create Inspiring Learning Experiences

  • Lead the development of engaging, innovative and accessible learning experiences, working closely with the Content Designers within your team to translate Education and commercial priorities into high-quality learning content.
  • Oversee learning across face-to-face, digital and blended channels, ensuring content is globally aligned, commercially relevant and designed for reuse across Retail, Spa and International audiences wherever possible.
  • Ensure the eHub continues to evolve as a valuable learning platform for colleagues and partners across the business, while encouraging innovation, embracing new technologies and continually looking for opportunities to enhance the learner experience.
  • Create a strong feedback loop between the Content Designers and field training team, using insight from learners, trainers and commercial stakeholders to continually improve both the content we create and the way it is delivered.

Education Events & Experiences

  • Lead the Education strategy and delivery for key ELEMIS events, ensuring every experience reflects our brand standards, education priorities and commercial ambitions.
  • Ensure Education resource is planned effectively and that trainers are fully prepared, briefed and deployed to deliver exceptional experiences including conferences, roadshows, product launches, partner events and key commercial moments.
  • Partnering with key stakeholders to agree event objectives, Education requirements and measures of success.
  • Personally representing ELEMIS Education at key strategic events where appropriate.
  • Review event outcomes and using feedback, engagement and commercial results to continuously improve future activity.

  • Extensive leadership experience within Education, Learning & Development within the retail sector.
  • People Leader: expert in developing high-performing field teams, nurturing and succession planning talent.
  • Content expertise: Applied deep expertise in content, enhancing creative, content and learning-design capability within the team.
  • Commercial awareness: directly impact business performance through execution of the learning strategy.
  • Continuous optimisation: able to measure impact of learning delivery and use feedback to inform roadmap for optimisation.
  • Innovation: delivers best-in-class learning methodology, tools and assets, support the team to operate with a test-and-learn mindset and engage in experimentation to remain relevant.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Travel: willingness to travel across the UK and internationally when required.


  • We operate a Hybrid working model which means working any three days in our Baker Street or Farringdon Head Office/or in Field, and two days working from home. We also operate with flexible working hours, which means core hours are between 10am - 4pm.
  • 27 days holiday per year.
  • Additional day off for your Birthday!
  • Generous Staff Discount on all your favourite ELEMIS products and spa treatments, as well as discounts on L'OCCITANE Group products (including L'Occitane, Erborian and more).
  • Annual Bonus.
  • Excellent well-being policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity policies, Income Protection, Life Assurance and more.
  • Generous Holiday Allowance, increasing with length of service.
  • Company Pension Scheme.
  • Healthcare Cash Plan (with Dental).
  • Employee Assistance Programme for all Associates and their families.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme, Season Ticket Loan, Length of Service Awards.
  • Much, much more!

title: CollectWise — AI Agent Engineer

description:

Type: Full-time | Hybrid (3+ days/week on-site) | Flatiron/NoMad, New York, NY Compensation: $200K–$300K + 0.25%–1% equity Hiring count: 1 Visa sponsorship: Open to visa transfers (e.g. OPT, H-1B transfers) for strong candidates; no blanket new-visa sponsorship Reports to: Sean O'Brien, Founder / CEO

About CollectWise

CollectWise automates late-stage consumer debt collection with AI. The platform handles the entire recovery process for creditors — asset research, pre-legal outreach, litigation, credit reporting, and enforcement actions like garnishments and liens — via AI agents that reportedly outperform human collectors by 2x at a fraction of the cost.

Founded: 2024 | Team size: 8 | Total funding: $7M (YC + Unpopular Ventures) Industry: Financial Services, AI, Fintech Website: Office: NoMad, New York, NY

Data conflict: The Paraform company-info panel lists total funding as $500,000, but the role highlights and the intake call both state $7M. $7M used here. Confirm.

Why Candidates Should Join

  • Own the whole stack: Build the entire voice AI infrastructure from scratch on LiveKit — powering ~10M calls/month in production, with full autonomy and no management layers.
  • Early-stage upside: YC-backed (Fall '24), ~$2.5M ARR in under 18 months, targeting $10M ARR next year. 0.25%–1% equity.
  • Real PMF in a large market: AI agents already beating human collectors 2x in a ~$35B US market.
  • Direct founder access: 8-person team, reporting directly to the founder/CTO — high impact per head.

Intake Call Summary

  • Automates debt collection with AI agents; ~$2.5M ARR, $7M funding, targeting $10M next year.
  • Hiring an AI engineer to build in-house voice AI infrastructure with complete ownership of a system handling 10M calls/month.
  • Team of 8, mostly engineers, reporting directly to founder or CTO.
  • Requirements: 3–7 yrs voice AI frameworks (LiveKit preferred); AWS, Node.js/JavaScript essential; founding/startup experience a plus.
  • Comp $200K–$300K incl. equity; hybrid 3 days in-office; no visa sponsorship available (see conflict note).

  • Interview: initial screen paid take-home technical interview with CTO.
  • Pain point: low volume of qualified voice-AI candidates in prior sourcing.

The Role

Build CollectWise's entire voice AI infrastructure in-house on LiveKit, owning end-to-end development of a voice orchestration framework powering ~10M calls/month.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build the in-house voice orchestration framework on LiveKit from scratch
  • Migrate all existing AI agents from the current voice provider to the new LiveKit-based system
  • Own prompt engineering and conversation design for voice agents handling millions of consumer interactions
  • Optimize real-time voice performance (latency, turn-taking, state management) at production scale
  • Build testing and evaluation frameworks to continuously improve agent performance and business outcomes

Tech stack: Node.js, AWS, SQL, LiveKit, Voice AI, ASR/STT/TTS, LLMs, Python

Seniority

  • 3–8 years of experience in voice AI infrastructure and backend engineering [Required]

Work Experience

  • Built production voice AI systems at scale (e.g. LiveKit, similar voice frameworks) [Required]
  • Built voice/agentic systems from scratch — ideally as founding engineer or at an early-stage startup [Required]
  • Experience at reputable voice AI companies [Strongly preferred]
  • Big Tech (Google, Meta, Roblox) OK if combined with startup or voice AI side projects [Strongly preferred]

Education

  • CS degree or related technical field from a strong university [Strongly preferred]

Hard Skills

  • Voice AI framework experience — LiveKit strongly preferred [Must have]
  • Node.js / JavaScript and AWS proficiency [Required]
  • Prompt engineering and conversational flow design for voice agents [Strongly preferred]

Soft Skills

  • Strong written communication — needed for prompt engineering and conversation design work [Required]

Miscellaneous

  • Based in NYC — hybrid 3+ days/week in Flatiron office [Required]

Data conflict: Seniority badge reads 3–8 years [Required]; the role description and intake call both say 3–7 years. Scoring against 3–8 pending confirmation.

Traits to Avoid

  • No voice AI or agentic experience — pure backend/SWE with zero voice/conversational AI

Role Details

  • Equity | 0.25%–1%

title: Architectural Technologist
description:
Architectural Technologist
Wrexham | Full-Time

Are you an Architectural Technologist looking for the opportunity to work on varied, interesting projects while developing your technical and design skills within an established practice?

We are currently working with an established, multi-disciplinary architectural practice based in Wrexham, with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality architectural and design solutions across a diverse range of sectors.

The practice has a long-established presence in the region and works across Wales, the North West and wider UK, with an impressive portfolio spanning education, healthcare, commercial and heritage projects.

They are now looking to strengthen their Wrexham team with an Architectural Technologist, and are open to considering candidates at different stages of their career.

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity for either:

• A recent Architectural Technology graduate or junior Technologist, with up to around two years' experience, who is enthusiastic, technically minded and keen to learn and develop within an established practice; or

• A more experienced Architectural Technologist who can bring strong technical detailing, construction knowledge and the ability to run projects and take responsibility for delivering work.

You will have the opportunity to work across a genuinely varied portfolio, including healthcare, education, commercial and heritage projects, giving you exposure to different building types, construction methods and project stages.

The practice's portfolio includes significant education projects, commercial and industrial developments and specialist heritage work, providing a particularly broad technical environment for an Architectural Technologist to develop their career.

Key Responsibilities

Depending on your level of experience, you will be involved in:

• Developing architectural and technical information from concept through to construction.
• Producing detailed drawings and documentation using Autodesk Revit.
• Preparing detailed construction drawings, specifications and schedules.
• Developing design proposals and resolving technical details.
• Working collaboratively with architects, designers, consultants and other project stakeholders.
• Liaising with clients, contractors and other members of the project team where appropriate.
• Supporting planning and building regulations submissions.
• Contributing to projects through technical design and construction stages.
• For experienced candidates, taking greater responsibility for project delivery, technical coordination and job running.

About You

The key requirement is a genuine enthusiasm for architectural technology and a desire to produce technically strong, well-considered buildings.

Essential:

• Degree/HND/HNC or equivalent qualification in Architectural Technology or a related discipline.
• Proficiency in Autodesk Revit - this is an essential requirement.
• Good understanding of architectural construction and technical detailing.
• Strong attention to detail and an organised approach to your work.
• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team.
• Good communication skills and a professional approach.

For junior candidates, the practice is particularly interested in people who demonstrate enthusiasm, initiative and a willingness to learn, rather than simply focusing on years of experience.

For more experienced Technologists, experience of technical delivery, detailing and running projects will be highly valued.

Why Apply?

This is a great opportunity to join an established practice where you can work on varied and technically interesting projects rather than being restricted to a single sector.

For an ambitious junior or graduate, the role offers the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, gain exposure to multiple project stages and build a strong technical foundation.

For an experienced Architectural Technologist, it offers the chance to take ownership of projects, use your technical expertise and play an important role within a growing and established Wrexham-based team.

title: Parks & Recreation Building Attendant

The successful candidate will remain calm under pressure, use sound judgment, respond appropriately to unexpected or emergency situations, and know when additional assistance is needed.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, takes pride in being dependable, and can confidently balance customer service, facility oversight, and public safety responsibilities.

  • Answer telephone calls, respond to questions, and direct inquiries to the appropriate person or department when needed.
  • Assist customers of different ages, backgrounds, and abilities with patience, courtesy, and respect.
  • Support renters and facility users by answering questions, communicating expectations, and helping create a positive customer experience.
  • Monitor activity throughout the complex and ensure that patrons understand and follow facility rules, safety requirements, and Parks and Recreation policies.
  • Conduct regular rounds of buildings and grounds, particularly during evening shifts, to identify safety, security, maintenance, or policy concerns.

  • Assist with light cleaning, minor maintenance needs, room setup, and special projects as assigned.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional front desk and general work area.
  • Communicate important information clearly and promptly to supervisors, coworkers, renters, and the public.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal Building Attendant is:

  • Friendly, approachable, patient, and genuinely interested in helping others.
  • Comfortable communicating with children, adults, seniors, families, organized groups, and members of the public.
  • Dependable and able to report to scheduled shifts punctually.
  • Confident working independently, including during evening hours in a large facility.
  • Observant and proactive about safety, security, and customer needs.
  • Able to remain composed, professional, and courteous during stressful or unexpected situations.
  • Capable of evaluating available information, solving routine problems, and making responsible decisions.
  • Resourceful, self-motivated, and willing to take initiative within the responsibilities of the position.
  • Able to accept direction and constructive feedback while working cooperatively with supervisors and coworkers.
  • Professional in appearance, conduct, communication, and care of the facility.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduation from high school or possession of a GED equivalent.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age at the time of hire.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Basic proficiency in reading, writing, recordkeeping, and interpersonal communication.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and professionally in person and by telephone.
  • Ability to learn and accurately explain facility services, schedules, reservation procedures, fees, rules, and policies.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, renters, patrons, and members of the public.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service while appropriately and respectfully enforcing facility policies.
  • Ability to work independently with limited on-site supervision.
  • Ability to recognize safety or security concerns and respond according to established procedures.
  • Ability to think clearly, exercise sound judgment, and maintain self-control under pressure.
  • Ability to maintain accurate records and handle cash responsibly.
  • Ability to learn new duties, adjust to changing situations, and manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Ability to maintain appropriate confidentiality and professionalism when handling customer or incident information.

Physical Requirements

This position requires frequent standing, walking, bending, twisting, and moving throughout a large, complex facility. The employee must be able to regularly lift and move items weighing approximately 25-50 pounds and perform light cleaning, facility setup, and related operational duties.

Work Schedule and Environment

This position requires a flexible schedule that may include:

  • Evening and nighttime hours
  • Saturdays and Sundays
  • Holidays
  • Special events
  • Periods of independent work with limited on-site supervision

Building Attendants may be responsible for monitoring and securing the facility at night. Applicants must be comfortable working independently in this environment and responding appropriately to routine concerns, unexpected situations, and emergencies.

Supervision Received

Works under the general supervision of the Parks and Recreation Director or designated supervisor.

Performance Expectations

Successful performance includes:

  • Providing consistently friendly, helpful, and professional service.
  • Completing work thoroughly, accurately, efficiently, and in an organized manner.
  • Learning facility operations, policies, systems, services, and assigned responsibilities.
  • Recognizing and resolving routine problems while appropriately escalating serious concerns.
  • Demonstrating reliability, punctuality, initiative, accountability, and sound decision-making.
  • Remaining adaptable and composed when priorities or circumstances change.
  • Cooperating with supervisors and coworkers and responding constructively to feedback.
  • Maintaining professional conduct and a clean, orderly work environment.
  • Meeting the performance standards established by Tooele County.

description:
As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) Lead with bioMérieux, you will play an important role in fostering relationships with internal and external stakeholders in your designated geographical area. This is a multifaceted role that combines scientific expertise, field medical affairs responsibilities, people and team management. Your position oversees an area team of field-based Medical Science Liaisons (MSL) who support bioMerieux Microbiology, Molecular, and Immunoassay portfolios.


Medical Science Liaison and Lead responsibilities include engaging with leading experts in the field to develop and maintain peer-to-peer relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and Healthcare Providers (HCPs) in areas relevant to infectious diseases and diagnostics. This role is key in providing scientific and clinical expertise on diagnostic products to internal and external stakeholders.


You will lead and mentor a regional team of MSLs, providing guidance on scientific engagement, medical education, insights gathering, and professional development. You will support your team to develop and implement strategic individual plans aligned with US and Global medical affairs objectives. MSL Lead is committed to successful area execution of field tactics as outlined by US Medical Affairs strategic planning process and is responsible for aggregating and communicating area activity and insights to demonstrate alignment with strategic plan.


As a regional leader within the US Medical Affairs organization, the MSL Lead collaborates regularly with cross-functional teams, including leadership from field sales, marketing, global medical affairs, customer support teams, and other functions within US Medical Affairs.

Primary Duties
KOL Engagement & Relationship Building

  • Develop and maintain a strong, collaborative network of relationships with KOLs, HCPs, and key stakeholders in your Area.
  • Mentor and develop area MSL team in competencies to build a network of KOLs and HCPs
  • Report regularly on KOL development progress for the designated geographic area
  • Cultivate partnerships with thought leaders to support the company’s medical strategy and therapeutic objectives and mentor area team in the development of key partnerships
  • Engage in ongoing scientific discussions to share relevant data and insights, fostering trust and facilitating mutual understanding with internal and external stakeholders

Medical Education & Scientific Presentations

  • Present scientific information on bioMérieux products and therapeutic areas, in alignment with the company’s strategic priorities, to internal and external audiences
  • Coordinate team MSL activities across assigned geographic designation in alignment with strategic priorities
  • Mentor and coach new and current team members in territory management, delivery of scientific presentations, and strategic delivery of medical education to regional stakeholders in alignment with medical plans

Insights Gathering & Reporting

  • Collect and analyze insights from team across designated geographic region to inform internal strategic direction
  • Provide detailed feedback to medical affairs leadership on area trends, impactful findings, and evidence gaps as identified through regional team insight-gathering activities
  • Collaborate with other regional MSL Leads to understand, interpret, and relay field insights to key internal stakeholders
  • Coach and mentor a team of MSLs to effectively gather insights as outlined in individual medical plans, and in alignment with US and Global medical objectives

Scientific Literature Review & Evidence-Based Information

  • Stay up to date with the latest research and scientific publications in relevant disease areas
  • Review and interpret scientific data to effectively communicate product and disease state information to internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Coach and develop team to effectively appraise and interpret scientific literature, including the development of Sr. MSLs who serve as key peer mentors for junior MSL team members

Regional Conference Engagement

  • Support strategic plan to identify and designate area team attendance at relevant regional medical and scientific conferences within your assigned geographic area, to network with KOLs, gather insights, and share bioMérieux’s latest advancements
  • Utilize these opportunities to strengthen relationships and stay informed about emerging trends in the medical field

Collaboration with Internal Teams

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., U.S. and Global Medical Affairs, Sales, Marketing, CSO, Regulatory Affairs) to align on company goals and share insights that impact strategic direction
  • Actively participate and mentor team members’ participation in integrated medical teams, and foster effective communication between integrated teams and area MSL team
  • Ensure alignment and execution of priority tactics outlined in integrated medical planning
  • MSL lead has a demonstrated ability to understand the needs and trends of a geographic area

Team Leadership Responsibilities

  • Recruit and onboard new team members within a designated geographic area, to align with regional medical and business needs
  • Conduct performance assessments throughout the year and address concerns in partnership with the Associate Director and Human Resources Business Partner
  • Collaborate with other area MSL and Product Leads as well as Medical Education and Training manager to support new hire training pathway
  • Ensure ongoing competency and compliance with team field medical affairs activities, as assessed through field ride-alongs, coaching, and auditing of CRM activity
  • Work with team members to identify professional development plans
  • Model compliance with bioMerieux’s professional standards and ethical decision-making practices

Administrative Responsibilities

  • Complete necessary administrative tasks, including expense reporting, internal training, vendor credentialing, data entry and review, and maintain accurate records
  • Maintain administrative oversight of area MSL team to ensure timely and compliant completion of expense reports, internal training, CRM documentation, and other administrative requirements
  • Ensure team complies with and follows all regulatory and company-specific guidelines when documenting insights, providing scientific information, and submitting reports

Tools & Technology Proficiency

  • Demonstrate proficiency with relevant tools and software such as CRM, Microsoft Office (Teams, PowerPoint, OneNote, Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.)
  • Perform all work in compliance with company quality procedures and standards
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Direct supervision: 1–5 employees
  • Scope includes both short-term operational decisions with little oversight and long-term strategic decisions with supervisory review


Qualifications
Required Education, Training and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required in life sciences, healthcare or clinical sciences.
  • 6+ years of relevant clinical, laboratory, or healthcare experience, with experience demonstrating progressive leadership, influence, or responsibility.
  • Clinical or clinical laboratory experience required. Relevant clinical experience may include patient-focused practice in areas such as infectious disease, critical care, emergency medicine, pharmacy, or other hospital/health-system settings. Relevant clinical laboratory experience includes roles involving clinical microbiology, diagnostic testing, laboratory medicine, or oversight/management of a hospital clinical laboratory.
  • Candidates should demonstrate the ability to lead and develop others, and translate their clinical/scientific expertise into a field medical environment.

Preferred Education, Training and Experience

  • Advanced degree strongly preferred: PhD, PharmD, NP, PA, MS/MLS/DCLS, MD/DO, or similar relevant advanced degree.
  • MSL/field medical affairs experience preferred, particularly experience involving HCP/KOL engagement, scientific/medical education, insights gathering, and field-based medical strategy.
  • Clinical microbiology board certification or similar relevant clinical laboratory credential is preferred for candidates whose background is primarily in clinical laboratory medicine.
  • Experience in infectious disease diagnostics, microbiology, molecular diagnostics, immunoassay, or related diagnostic areas is preferred.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Consistently upholds and reflects the core ethical principles and values that bioMérieux promotes
  • Analyze data and make decisions/recommendations, using data to guide decision-making and provide suggestions for improvement
  • Effective Presentation Skills, including the ability to present technical data
  • Ability to work cross-functionally
  • Organizing work and resources efficiently
  • Functional skills including critical thinking, adaptability, time management, communication, problem-solving, and digital literacy
  • Skilled in MS Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel) at an intermediate level
  • Knowledge and understanding of the regional health system landscape is desired
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire teams with an analytical and strategic mindset
  • Deep scientific and clinical knowledge in diagnostics; knowledge of the infectious disease diagnostics market preferred


Working Conditions & Physical Requirements

  • Domestic travel: 70%
  • International travel: 0%

The estimated salary range for this field-based role is between $165,200 and $204,100 per year. This role is eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and individual performance per bioMerieux’s bonus program. This range may differ from ranges offered for similar positions elsewhere in the country given differences in cost of living. Actual compensation within this range is determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and will be presented in writing at the time of the offer.
In addition, bioMérieux offers a competitive Total Rewards package that may include:
  • A choice of medical (including prescription), dental, and vision plans providing nationwide coverage and telemedicine options
  • Company-Provided Life and Accidental Death Insurance
  • Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Retirement Plan including a generous non-discretionary employer contribution and employer match.
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Wellness Programs
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Various voluntary benefit offerings
  • Discount programs
  • Parental leaves

title: Project Manager, Installation and Commissioning (Battery Storage)
description:
Saving the World! Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises. We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience. We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Project Manager to join our Battery Storage deployment team.

In this role, you will oversee the planning, coordination, and execution of behind-the-meter battery storage projects, including site readiness, equipment delivery and staging, installation, utility interconnection, permitting, and commissioning. You will work closely with subcontractors, electrical contractors, and utility partners to ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.

This position demands strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proven experience managing electrical field installations. The Project Manager may also support additional energy-saving efforts, such as solar, EV charging, or lighting and HVAC conservation projects, contributing to broader sustainability and resource management goals.

Why this Role is Important:
This role is essential for deploying battery energy storage that reduces peak demand charges, improves site resiliency, and enables participation in utility demand response and grid services programs. By overseeing safe, code-compliant BESS installations and commissioning, the Project Manager directly contributes to both environmental impact and operational savings.

Key Responsibilities:

Oversee contractor-led installations and commissioning of battery energy storage systems and associated electrical infrastructure, ensuring all work meets company standards for quality and safety, stays on schedule, and is delivered within budget across complex, multisite projects nationwide.

  • Work closely with contractors to forecast and schedule battery storage installations, ensuring timely execution and alignment with project timelines, equipment lead times, and resource availability.
  • Manage permitting, utility interconnection applications, and Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) inspections, tracking approvals and resolving jurisdictional requirements that impact project schedules.
  • Coordinate site readiness activities, including electrical service evaluation, load and metering data review, structural and clearance requirements, and equipment placement.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with contractors, fostering effective communication, collaboration, and accountability throughout project execution.
  • Monitor contractor performance by evaluating adherence to project schedules, budget constraints, safety requirements, and quality expectations, and provide feedback and guidance as necessary.
  • Oversee commissioning, startup, and acceptance testing, verifying that system controls, communications, and performance meet design intent prior to project closeout.
  • Enforce electrical safety and code compliance requirements, including NFPA 70 (NEC), NFPA 70E, and NFPA 855, ensuring contractors follow approved lockout/tagout and energized work practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, incentives, procurement, fulfillment, and install support, to ensure seamless project delivery.
  • Identify and mitigate risks and obstacles that may impact project timelines or quality, implementing corrective actions as needed.
  • Proactively communicate project status, updates, and potential delays to internal stakeholders and customers, maintaining strong relationships and delivering exceptional customer service.
  • Collaborate with Fulfillment and Procurement to manage the Bill of Materials (BOM) for each battery storage project, ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of batteries, inverters, switchgear, and balance-of-system materials to contractors.
  • Coordinate with Fulfillment/Procurement to resolve any issues related to material availability, quality, or delivery, ensuring timely resolutions to maintain project momentum.
  • Maintain accurate inventory and asset records, tracking serialized equipment and all project-related materials, ensuring proper documentation of usage, storage, and replenishment to prevent shortages and avoid project delays.
  • Ensure that all project documentation is accurate, complete, and up to date, including project plans, progress reports, change orders, commissioning records, warranty registrations, and closeout documentation.

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven experience in project management, preferably in battery energy storage, solar, or electrical construction.
  • Experience managing subcontractors overseeing electrical, energy storage, or construction projects.
  • Working knowledge of battery energy storage systems, inverters, switchgear, metering, and utility interconnection processes.
  • Familiarity with applicable codes and standards, including the NEC, NFPA 855, and UL 9540, and with local permitting and inspection processes, preferred.
  • Facilities management/building engineer experience preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to travel to project sites as needed, with flexible hours to align with contractor and field crew schedules.
Compensation
$85,000—$110,000 USD

Compensation is based on factors including level of experience, skillset, qualifications, and location.

What We Offer:

  • Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing, supportive company environment
  • Competitive pay
  • Full benefits package including medical, dental, vison, 401K, life insurance, and disability insurance
  • Opportunity to work as part of a team that values its members and works together to achieve positive change.

Budderfly is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status, and to affirmatively seek to advance the principles of equal employment opportunity.

We welcome all job seekers, including those with disabilities. If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Company’s career web page as a result of your disability.

title: Program Manager - Clinical Quality Improvement
description:
Our Mission

At CPCQC, we are dedicated to ensuring that EVERY pregnant and postpartum person, infant, and family in Colorado has access to safe, equitable, high-quality care. We champion new collaborations, strengthen community connections to care, and lead statewide maternal and infant health quality improvement initiatives.

As a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization, CPCQC partners with healthcare facilities, community organizations, and families across Colorado and with national allies to advance best practices and improve maternal and infant health outcomes.

Our Core Values

At CPCQC, we are:

  • Better Together
  • Person-Centered
  • Action-Oriented
  • Joyfully Invested
  • Committed to Integrity
  • Leveraging Expertise
  • Always Learning

We work to prevent maternal mortality and morbidity, inform and implement evidence-based policies, and address health disparities in maternal and infant health. Our work is complex, multifaceted, and profoundly important, and we look forward to welcoming a new team member to help increase our impact.

Position Description

The Program Manager – Clinical Quality Improvement oversees a quality improvement initiative to reduce maternal mortality and morbidity, implementing an AIM Patient Safety Bundle-based program across hospitals. This position is part of CPCQC’s Clinical Quality Improvement (QI) team and reports to the Director of Quality Improvement. The Program Manager works in close partnership with a dedicated Quality Improvement (QI) Advisor and is supported by peer Program Managers in the organization. The role also collaborates regularly with the data and analytics, community QI, policy and community engagement, and communications and grant reporting leads, whose work cuts across programs to support impact.

The primary initiative for this role is SOAR, CPCQC’s primary cesarean reduction initiative. The Program Manager leads SOAR by guiding strategy, hospital engagement, data, and reporting from planning through evaluation and coordinates with peer Program Managers across CPCQC’s broader clinical and community QI portfolio, including Turning the Tide, SPARK, and NEST.

This full-time, salaried position operates remotely within Colorado. However, travel includes attendance at quarterly in-person meetings in the Denver Metro area, visits to partner and hospital sites statewide, and attendance at forums and conferences hosted by CPCQC or key state, regional, or national partners.

Responsibilities

Program & Initiative Management

  • Lead the implementation, tracking, and evaluation of SOAR, CPCQC’s primary cesarean reduction initiative, ensuring it meets goals and creates measurable impact.
  • Support planning and co-facilitate monthly initiative meetings and steering committee meetings that guide strategy and execution, coordinating agendas, speakers, and clinical/technical-assistance content with your QI Advisor and sending materials to hospital teams in advance.
  • Manage initiative calendars and workplans, including grant deliverables, deadlines, enrollment cycles, and educational and conference opportunities.
  • Maintain the hospital engagement tracker and detailed initiative documentation, ensuring timely, well-organized communication with hospital participants on logistics and resources.
  • Lead annual planning and strategy for your initiative, including logic models, KPIs, and updates to program materials such as toolkits, checklists, and one-pagers.
  • Plan annual outreach, recruitment, and cohort onboarding in coordination with the Communications team.
  • Track and communicate about your program budget with the Director of Finance and Operations and the Accounting team, including spenddown planning and timely reimbursements.

Data Strategy & Grant Reporting

  • Oversee initiative deliverables, partnering with your QI Advisor and the Data team to interpret and share quality data with participants.
  • Collaborate with the initiative QI Advisor to promote timely, accurate hospital data submission (e.g., via REDCap) and review current dashboards and data visualizations.
  • Collaborate with the initiative QI Advisor to identify data gaps with the Director of QI and Data team, and incorporate data and findings into quarterly and annual grant reports.
  • Contribute to grant reporting and contract compliance, ensuring program alignment with scopes of work and responding to funder requests (e.g., CDC, CDPHE, HCPF) promptly.

Health Equity

  • Evaluate and strengthen how health equity is prioritized across your initiative by deepening equity-centered conversations, data analysis, and outcome objectives in partnership with your QI Advisor.

Team Coordination & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead the weekly internal initiative meeting by preparing the agenda in Asana, facilitating discussion and decisions, and tracking follow-up tasks for the team.
  • Maintain regular touchpoints with your QI Advisor (email, Slack, or Zoom) to ensure role clarity, workload balance, and consistent hospital messaging.
  • Participate in the QI Huddle, bi-weekly all-team meeting, bi-weekly data team meeting, and PM team meetings to coordinate work, align programming, and surface risks early.
  • Coordinate education and training offerings, such as Labor Support Workshops, lived-experience sessions, and webinars, including CE coordination, logistics, evaluation, and materials.
  • Escalate issues promptly and appropriately, following the chain of command (peer → Director → CEO).

Partnerships, Development & Communications

  • Represent CPCQC with external partners and networks (e.g., HCPF, other state PQCs, CDPHE) and in committees and workgroups, preparing agendas and sharing timely follow-up.
  • Communicate CPCQC’s objectives and initiative outcomes to hospitals, partners, and the broader community.
  • Collaborate or lead on quality improvement publications, including posters, abstracts, podium presentations, and journal articles.
  • Work with the communications team on newsletter updates, social media and thought leadership, and presenting at conferences across Colorado, and potentially nationally, on the impact and lessons of CPCQC’s initiatives.

Position Requirements

  • 2–5 years of progressive leadership experience in the nonprofit or healthcare sector, with experience in maternal and child health initiatives preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree (required) or master’s degree (preferred) in a clinically relevant field, public health, healthcare management, or a related field.
  • Experience working directly with healthcare providers and hospital systems on community health initiatives.
  • Ability to travel across the state for hospital visits and trainings several times per year.
  • Strong commitment to valuing diversity and equity in the workplace.
  • Proven operational leadership skills, including project management, strategic planning, and analysis.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and communication skills essential for coordinating multiple projects and stakeholders.
  • Relationship-building skills to engage effectively with team members, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Comfort using project management and data tools (e.g., Asana, REDCap, shared dashboards, and Google Workspace) to keep work organized, transparent, and on schedule.

Salary and Benefits

This is a full-time, salaried position working in the state of Colorado. While this position is remote, there is an expectation to attend events and meetings in person across the state as needed. Candidates currently not residing within the state of Colorado will be required to relocate within 6 months of hire at their own expense. The annual salary range for this position is $75,000-$80K based on qualifications. This position also includes a benefit package (medical, dental, retirement), 401k, and unlimited vacation. Please check out the CPCQC website () to learn more about our work and current projects.

title: AWS Technical Architect
description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

AS AN AWS TECHNICAL ARCHITECT, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

  • Ensure customer success in building and launching Amazon Connect solutions for NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture customers
  • Conduct technology assessment and audits to identify the need (from an ROI and Outcomes perspective) to move to CCaaS AWS Connect Platform, improving agent experience and productivity
  • Facilitate business process reviews to identify customer requirements and processes
  • Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Lead discovery for customers, help customers build ROIs for projects, and deliver presentations and estimate for delivering that ROI
  • Translate customer requirements into contact center design, leveraging best practices, and other AWS Services
  • Oversee and mentor technical teams, providing guidance and support to ensure that proposed solution (on Salesforce and AWS Cloud) is delivered on time, on budget, and to the required quality standards
  • Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, communicating technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner, and managing expectations and priorities
  • Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery
  • Effectively manage all aspects of project and customer communications
  • Deliver customer end user training and documentation
  • Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management
  • Lead vision and strategy discussions with contact center and customer service leadership and management

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Customer-facing contact center experience
  • Experience building integrations across WFM, CRM, and contact center solutions
  • Experience with communications protocols and APIs such as WebRTC and SIP
  • Experience with hands-on Scripting/coding (e.g., python, java, c#, .NET, Node.js)
  • Communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, IT Management, and customers
  • API integration experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Experience with Cloudformation, Contact Flow Design, Lambda Integration, Lex Integration, and Call Center Routing
  • Proficient in understanding and documenting the infrastructure requirements and specifications, including resource types, networking, security, and compliance needs.
  • Knowledge of automation tools and frameworks for building, testing, and deploying software, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CodeDeploy
  • Contact Center architecture knowledge
  • Experienced in implementing infrastructure as code using AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) and Terraform, ensuring consistent and efficient infrastructure deployment.
  • Capable of setting up monitoring and logging for infrastructure components and performing ongoing maintenance to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture
  • Salesforce knowledge and familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Contact center product knowledge of other platforms (Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio, etc.)
  • Experience with WorkForce Management solutions
  • Experience working with outbound dialers and campaign management
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification
  • AWS Developer Associate Certification or Professional
  • AWS Solution Architect Certification or Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

title: Pillar Lead: Indentity Architect (R-00210)
description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

True Zero is seeking an Identity Architect to lead the Identity pillar and establish reusable Zero Trust identity architecture patterns. The role defines identity relationships, authentication and authorization models, access policy, privileged access approaches, and integration requirements that enable identity-centric security decisions across VA systems.

The Identity Architect works closely with application, network, device, data, and automation specialists to ensure identity context is consistently incorporated into enterprise use cases and system implementations.

Position Responsibilities

  • Develop identity-centric architecture patterns for enterprise Zero Trust Use Cases.
  • Define authentication, authorization, federation, identity proofing, privileged access, conditional access, and lifecycle integration requirements.
  • Map identity signals to policy decision and enforcement points across applications, networks, devices, and workloads.
  • Assess existing identity technologies for interoperability, consolidation opportunities, and alignment to target-state Zero Trust capabilities.
  • Support system implementation plans, pilots, testing, validation, and architecture reviews.
  • Document identity dependencies, deviations, risks, and lessons learned for reuse across future implementation waves.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Seven or more years of identity and access management architecture or engineering experience.
  • Deep knowledge of federation, SSO, MFA, conditional access, PKI, PAM, identity governance, and modern authentication protocols.
  • Strong understanding of Zero Trust identity principles and policy-based access control.
  • Experience integrating identity services across cloud, hybrid, and legacy environments.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, PIV/CAC, PAM, IGA, or comparable enterprise identity platforms.
    • Experience supporting Federal identity requirements.
    • Experience with workload identity and machine-to-machine authentication patterns.

    Preferred Certifications:

    One or more of the following is preferred:
    • CISSP
    • Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator
    • Okta certification
    • Security+
