title: QA Lead
description:
Job Title: QA Lead

Reports to: Engineering Manager, SRE & QA

Location: Ireland (remote)

Purpose

We are hiring a QA Lead who starts hands-on to run our QA team day to day. You will be embedded in one pod as a Quality Engineer, the same as the rest of the team, and you will also lead that team: three Quality Engineers report to you. You are the connection between the Engineering Manager and the QA team. The Engineering Manager sets quality strategy and direction. You turn it into day-to-day practice, feed the team's reality back up, and carry the operational load of goal setting, performance reviews, coaching, and reviewing your team's work. You stay hands-on and technical throughout.

Most of your quality leverage is upstream. Our pods spec features in depth and hand them to coding agents that build the feature and its tests together. Inside your pod you are the advocate, not the executor: the voice asking the awkward questions, pushing the failure modes nobody thought of, and making sure the spec and our shared testing skills are good enough that the agent produces the right tests, at the right level, catching the right things. Expect to be hands-on early while that foundation is still thin. Expect that to reduce deliberately over time as the skills sharpen and the pod's own quality thinking matures.

Key Responsibilities

  • QA Team Leadership: Lead the three Quality Engineers who report to you. Set their goals, run their performance reviews, coach them day to day, and review their work. You are the senior voice they turn to on what good looks like and what to do next, and the first escalation point when they are stuck.
  • Spec-Time Advocacy: Be in the room while the pod specs a feature, before any code exists. Ask the awkward questions, push the edge cases and failure modes nobody has thought of, and hold the line that acceptance criteria are testable and traceable. A vague spec produces vague tests, so this is where most of your quality leverage lives.
  • Agentic Test Quality: Our coding agents write most of our tests. Curate what they are told: the shared testing skills, patterns, and guardrails that decide what gets tested, at what level, and how. Verify the output is load bearing using mutation testing, rather than assuming a green suite means a covered feature.
  • Coaching & Culture: Focus on coaching over absorbing workload. Review the tests that arrive with a pull request, whether a developer or an agent wrote them, asking probing questions to ensure they prove meaningful outcomes. You raise the developers' ceiling by mentoring them on test efficacy.
  • Fold Back and Compound: A lesson that only lands in one spec is a lesson we pay for twice. When something is missed, get the reasoning back into the shared skills, gates and patterns so the next feature starts better than the last. This is what makes the role shrink rather than grow: every fold-back reduces how much intervention the next feature needs from you.
  • Hands-on When It Counts: Coach rather than cover. You still open the editor for exploratory testing, a missing test, a gnarly end-to-end flow, or awkward test data, but that is the exception rather than how you spend your week. Expect this to be heavier in your first months and lighter as the skills mature. That reduction is the point.
  • Holistic Quality: Help the team integrate performance, security, and accessibility into our quality practices. You contribute to ensuring accessibility is asserted against our live shared config.

The Person

  • Technical Lead: You are comfortable in the code and review your team's work to ensure high standards. You lead by evidence, using traces, benchmarks, and reproduction scripts to help the team make decisions.
  • Systemic Thinker: You look beyond individual bugs to identify pipeline or architectural failures. You contribute to engineering systemic solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Evidence-Based Guide: You help the team understand success through metrics like mutation scores, flake rates, and production escapes, using this data to guide improvements.
  • Collaborative Influencer: You thrive in cross-functional pods, partnering with product managers and engineers to embed quality into the development lifecycle.
  • Proactive Partner: You champion the user perspective by questioning assumptions and identifying potential failure modes before development begins.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of software testing experience in a commercial environment with 3+ years acting as a technical lead in QA teams.
  • B.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent lifetime experience.
  • Formal leadership experience, including performance management of a team.
  • Experience in architectural and pipeline design to prevent systemic failures.
  • Hands-on experience building with agentic tools and workflows, focusing on prompt engineering and LLM-based testing frameworks.
  • Proficiency in performance, security, and accessibility testing.
  • Experience working with modern CI/CD platforms and DevOps best practices.
  • Proficiency in JIRA or similar project management tools.
  • Expertise with automation tools like Cypress, Stryker, Allure, PactumJS, etc.

Leadership & Competencies

  • Quality Leadership: Proven experience in formal management, including goal setting, coaching, and performance reviews. You use data-driven insights—such as flake rates, escape rates, and mutation scores—to guide team decisions and improvements.
  • Directing Coding Agents: Expertise in writing and refining instructions for AI coding agents. You have the judgment to identify where they fail and utilize mutation testing to ensure generated suites provide meaningful coverage.
  • Collaborative Engineering: Strong advocate for shift-left practices. You mentor engineers in TDD and code review standards, thriving in a pairing environment to solve complex architectural challenges.

Attributes for Success at Adherent

  • Collaborative Mindset — Thrives in a team-oriented environment, values partnership, and demonstrates care and respect for colleagues to achieve shared goals.
  • Transformational Thinking — Embraces change and actively contributes to driving innovation and cultural evolution within the organisation.
  • Agility — Adapts quickly to shifting priorities and market demands, maintaining focus and effectiveness in a fast-paced environment.
  • Empowerment — Takes ownership of decisions and actions, demonstrating confidence in making autonomous choices that align with company goals.
  • Fearless Flexibility — Approaches challenges with an open mind, learns rapidly from setbacks, and adjusts strategies to navigate dynamic circumstances.
  • Innovation-Driven — Leverages creativity and cutting-edge technology to develop solutions that simplify complex problems and create competitive advantages.
  • Customer-Centric Focus — Obsess over delivering value to customers by understanding their needs and providing impactful solutions that build trust and loyalty.
  • Trustworthiness — Acts with integrity, builds credibility through consistent actions, and fosters an environment where others feel respected and valued.
  • Respect for Diversity — Values diverse perspectives, treats everyone with dignity, and cultivates an inclusive workplace that encourages new ideas and opinions.

title: Payload Product Assurance Engineer
description:
Description

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Payload Product Assurance Engineer to play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability and compliance of advanced space payload products throughout their lifecycle.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Programme teams, you will support the delivery of high-quality RF and microwave hardware for demanding Space and Defence applications.

Key Duties:

  • Lead product assurance activities across payload and space hardware programmes from concept through to customer delivery.

  • Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory and industry standards, including ECSS, ESA and NASA requirements.

  • Work with Engineering, Manufacturing and Test teams to embed quality throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Support the selection and qualification of space-grade electronic components and materials.

  • Review and approve quality plans, manufacturing documentation, non-conformance reports and release documentation.

  • Lead root cause investigations, corrective actions and Non-Conformance Review Boards (NRBs).

  • Participate in design reviews, manufacturing readiness reviews, customer reviews and programme gate reviews.

  • Monitor quality metrics, process capability and continuous improvement activities.

  • Maintain robust configuration control, traceability and product documentation.

  • Support supplier quality and material/process compliance activities.

Key Requirements:

  • Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, Physics, Quality or a related discipline.

  • Experience in Product Assurance, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing Quality or Reliability Engineering.

  • Experience working with complex electronic, RF, aerospace, defence or space products.

  • Strong understanding of quality management systems, non-conformance management and root cause analysis.

  • Knowledge of space-grade electronic components, PCB manufacturing and aerospace soldering standards.

  • Familiarity with ECSS, ESA or NASA quality standards.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

Desirable Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting satellite, payload or wider space programmes.

  • Knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 quality systems.

  • Experience with configuration management, FMEA, risk management, qualification or acceptance testing.

  • Experience supporting supplier or customer audits.

The Package:

  • Competitive salary depending on experience.

  • 37.5 hour working week.

  • 25 days' holiday plus public holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days.

  • Contributory pension scheme with up to 8% company contribution.

  • Life Assurance.

  • Income Protection Insurance.

  • SAYE share scheme.

  • Electric Vehicle (EV) scheme.

  • Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Volunteering day.

  • Learning and development opportunities.

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge Space and Defence programmes within a collaborative engineering environment.

  • Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression.

Additional Requirements:

  • Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

  • The successful candidate must satisfy UK Security Clearance requirements.

title: Principal, AI Strategy & Engineering Transformation
description:
Vantor is forging the new frontier of spatial intelligence, helping decision makers and operators navigate what’s happening now and shape what’s coming next. Vantor is a place for problem solvers, changemakers, and go-getters—where people are working together to help our customers see the world differently, and in doing so, be seen differently. Come be part of a mission, not just a job, where you can: Shape your own future, build the next big thing, and change the world.

To be eligible for this position, you must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen, permanent resident, Asylee, or Refugee.

Export Control/ITAR: Certain roles may be subject to U.S. export control laws, requiring U.S. person status as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Please review the job details below.

Vantor advances spatial intelligence by bringing together geospatial data, AI, and mission-focused technology to help decision makers understand what is happening now and shape what comes next. We are a team of problem solvers and builders working on consequential commercial and national-security challenges.

Please review the job details below.

Eligibility and Export Control

This role may support restricted or export-controlled engineering environments. Talent Acquisition, Legal, and Export Compliance must confirm any U.S. Person, citizenship, clearance, or other eligibility requirements before posting.

Role Overview

Vantor is seeking a Principal, AI Strategy & Engineering Transformation leader to turn AI from experimentation into a repeatable, secure, and measurable engineering capability. You will define the strategy for AI-assisted software delivery while remaining close enough to the work to build prototypes, test workflows, and help teams adopt them.

You will operate across Engineering, Product, Security, Compliance, IT, Infrastructure, Procurement, HR, and senior leadership. Your work will connect emerging AI technology to practical developer workflows, enterprise operating models, and decisions about what Vantor should standardize, scale, or stop.

This is a hands-on principal individual-contributor role with enterprise reach. You will lead primarily through technical credibility, evidence, facilitation, and influence rather than formal authority. The successful candidate can move from a working prototype to a governed pilot, an executive recommendation, and an adoption plan without losing the thread between them.

What You'll Own

AI Strategy & Developer Tooling

  • Define and maintain Vantor's strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for AI-assisted software engineering.
  • Evaluate AI development tools through representative workflows and evidence covering capability, security, compliance, cost, supportability, portability, and operating-model fit.
  • Recommend primary tools, approved patterns, exception paths, and bounded experiments for emerging capabilities such as local inference.

AI Workflow Development & Implementation (Hands-On)

  • Design, prototype, and validate agentic and AI-assisted workflows for coding, testing, documentation, code review, bug finding, repository automation, and workflow orchestration.
  • Build practical solutions with modern AI tooling, APIs, scripting, prompt and context engineering, and developer-tool integrations.
  • Move promising ideas from concept to prototype to reusable operating pattern, partnering with engineering teams when productionalization or platform support is required.

Engineering Workflow & Platform Transformation

  • Discover how teams plan, build, review, release, and operate software; identify friction, manual work, and high-value opportunities for AI and automation.
  • Redesign workflows across requirements, backlog management, development, testing, release coordination, documentation, and post-launch learning.
  • Lead or support foundational changes that affect engineering delivery, including source-control governance, collaboration integrations, workflow migrations, ownership models, and phased rollout planning.

Pioneer, Champion & Adoption Programs

  • Run structured pilots with real engineering teams, including readiness baselines, workflow selection, hands-on dogfooding, blocker removal, evidence collection, and scaling decisions.
  • Translate successful pilots into reusable playbooks, reference implementations, automation, templates, skills, and internal marketplace or knowledge-base assets.
  • Build adoption through embedded Pioneer and Champion networks; coach participants, facilitate teach-backs and demonstrations, run pulse checks, and help local leaders support teams with decreasing central assistance.

Secure, Responsible & Scalable AI

  • Partner with Security, Compliance, Privacy, IT, and engineering owners to establish practical governance and approved AI usage patterns.
  • Address identity, authorization, secrets, network and egress controls, data handling, storage, logging, retention, and human review as part of workflow design.
  • Design bounded pilots and deployment paths for regulated, restricted, or mission-sensitive environments without treating experimental infrastructure as broadly authorized.

Measurement & Executive Decision Support

  • Define success measures for adoption, developer friction, productivity, quality, useful outcomes, risk, and vendor value; establish baselines and collect before-and-after evidence.
  • Turn pilot and portfolio evidence into clear recommendations about what to continue, change, standardize, scale, or stop.
  • Operate a cross-functional portfolio through milestones, decision gates, dependencies, owners, risks, and concise leadership readouts; support vendor evaluation and procurement decisions with measurable evidence.

What Success Looks Like (12-18 Months)

  • Vantor has an accepted, evidence-backed AI development-tool strategy with clear default and exception paths.
  • Multiple AI-assisted workflows are used on real engineering work and have been converted into reusable, supported patterns.
  • Engineering teams and embedded Champions can apply proven practices with decreasing dependence on the central transformation function.
  • Sensitive and restricted use cases have approved operating paths, explicit boundaries, and named support owners.
  • Leadership can see measurable changes in adoption, delivery friction, quality, cycle time, risk, and business value.
  • Platform and workflow changes have clear ownership, practical migration plans, and evidence that they improve engineering delivery.

Why This Role Matters

AI will only create durable advantage when it changes how work is done safely, measurably, and at scale. This role connects technology strategy to the daily reality of engineering teams so Vantor can learn quickly without creating fragmented tools, unmanaged risk, or pilots that never become operating capability.

The person in this role will help Vantor convert emerging AI capabilities into better engineering outcomes, stronger internal expertise, and repeatable practices that teams can carry forward independently.

Minimum Requirements

  • 8+ years of relevant experience across software engineering, developer platforms, technical product or program leadership, engineering enablement, or enterprise technology transformation.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted workflows, agents, prototypes, integrations, or developer automation with modern generative-AI tools.
  • Strong understanding of the software delivery lifecycle, including Git-based workflows, CI/CD, testing, code review, repository automation, and secure development practices.
  • Ability to use programming or scripting, APIs, and automation tooling to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, and repeatable workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous opportunities into structured experiments, measurable outcomes, roadmaps, and clear decisions.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving engineers, senior leaders, platform owners, security, compliance, infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise security, data governance, responsible AI, and the controls needed to use AI safely in software delivery.
  • Proven ability to influence without direct authority, coach technical teams, facilitate working sessions, and drive adoption of unfamiliar tools or practices.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical evidence into concise executive recommendations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data or AI, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience deploying AI development tools in regulated, export-controlled, disconnected, or otherwise restricted environments.
  • Experience evaluating or scaling AI coding assistants, agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented systems, local inference, or related developer tooling.
  • Experience building Champion networks, communities of practice, embedded enablement models, or enterprise change programs.
  • Experience with developer-productivity measurement, experimentation, engineering metrics, or platform-value assessment.
  • Experience with GitHub Enterprise governance, source-control or collaboration-platform migrations, cloud platforms, and modern DevOps practices.
  • Experience supporting vendor evaluation, procurement, implementation planning, and sustainable operating or support models.

Compensation, Benefits & Posting Requirements

Talent Acquisition Finalization Required

Before posting, Talent Acquisition must add the approved reporting line, location and work model, requisition ID, eligibility and export-control language, salary and incentive ranges, benefits, application instructions, and current EEO, accommodation, and employment-privacy notices.

Pay Transparency: To support pay transparency, Vantor includes salary ranges in all U.S. job postings. Starting pay for this role will fall within the listed range and will be based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, location, and market conditions. Candidates who meet the minimum requirements for the role should not expect to receive compensation at the top of the range. The listed range reflects the expected pay for this position, and final offers will be determined based on each candidate’s experience, expertise, and alignment with the role.

● The base pay for this position within Colorado is: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 - $220,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within New Jersey is: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 - $220,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within Delaware is: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 - $220,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within the Washington, DC metropolitan area is: $165,000.00 - $220,000.00 - $242,000.00 annually.● The base pay for this position within California is: $150,000.00 - $200,000.00 - $220,000.00 annually.

For all other states, we use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop market-driven ranges for our roles, and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range.

Benefits: Vantor offers a competitive total rewards package that goes beyond the standard, including a robust 401(k) with company match, mental health resources, and unique perks like student loan repayment assistance, adoption reimbursement and pet insurance to support all aspects of your life. You can find more information on our benefits at: Vantor.com/careers

Additionally, this position is incentive eligible with a target based on contribution, company performance, and/or individual results achieved; the specific incentive plan and target amount will be determined based on the role and breadth of contributions.

The application window is three days from the date the job is posted and will remain posted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire. If the job is reposted regardless of reason, it will remain posted three days from the date the job is reposted and will remain reposted until a qualified candidate has been identified for hire.

The date of posting can be found on Vantor's Career page at the top of each job posting.

To apply, submit your application via Vantor's Career page.

EEO Policy: Vantor is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace. We believe in fostering an environment where all team members feel respected, valued, and encouraged to share their ideas. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Modeleur de personnages - Character Modeler (DNEG Animation)
description:
(English version below)
Rédigé au masculin pour alléger le texte
DNEG Animation est un studio de classe mondiale qui crée des longs métrages d'animation et des contenus épisodiques haut de gamme pour le public du monde entier. Nous agrandissons nos équipes mondiales afin de pouvoir mener à bien une série de nouveaux projets d'envergure. Rejoignez une équipe où le seul style maison est la qualité et travaillez aux côtés de certains des meilleurs talents du secteur pour donner vie à des personnages emblématiques et à des mondes uniques. Qu'il s'agisse d'adaptations complexes de romans graphiques ou de films magnifiquement stylisés, chaque projet est motivé par la passion de l'équipe pour le métier de l'animation et chaque rôle joue un rôle important dans le succès de nos émissions. Vous vous sentez inspiré ? Postulez dès maintenant pour faire partie de l'équipe de DNEG Animation et venez travailler avec nous sur des séries comme « The Garfield Movie “, ” Entergalactic “ et ” Nimona » !
Description du poste
Le candidat démontre une capacité à interpréter et à transposer un design de personnage en 3D. Les modeleurs de personnages devront fournir des modèles exceptionnels, tant sur le plan créatif que technique, et assurer la livraison des modèles dans les délais établis.
Étant donné que chaque projet est différent et nécessite une vision artistique unique, le candidat devra démontrer de grandes compétences pour s'adapter à tout style ou design et avoir une base solide sur les aspects techniques de la création de modèles de personnages.
Responsabilités principales
  • Créez des modèles de personnages CG uniques à l'aide du matériel de référence fourni.
  • Soumettez votre travail quotidiennement et assistez aux séances de révision de la production. Recevoir et adresser les notes artistiques et techniques.
  • Vérifiez la qualité de son travail pour qu’il soit conforme aux protocoles et standards de DNEG avant de le transférer aux autres départements en aval.
  • Apprendre et se familiariser avec les méthodologies et les outils de pipeline au sein du département de modélisation de DNEG.
  • Assister à diverses séances de révisions/discussions spécifiques au projet, à l'assemblée du département de modelling et à d'autres réunions obligatoires.

Exigences

  • Expérience de travail sur des longs métrages d'animation de styles artistiques variés.
  • Expérience de production en tant que modeleur de personnage.
  • Bonne compréhension de l'anatomie humaine et capacité de s'adapter à toutes les formes de vie organiques.
  • Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec votre chef d’équipe/superviseur de la modélisation pour assurer la qualité et la viabilité technique des modèles de personnages pour une production.
  • Capacité à communiquer efficacement vos idées, suggestions et questions avec les autres membres de l'équipe.
  • Expérience de sculpture numérique avec Maya et Zbrush.
  • Sens aiguisés pour les formes, l'échelle et les proportions.

Atouts
  • Diplôme en animation 3D et images de synthèses ou autres cours pertinents.
  • Connaissance des logiciels connexes, tels que Marvelous Designer.
Veuillez noter que ce poste est un poste syndiqué et qu'il sera couvert par une convention collective entre la société DNEG et IATSE dans les mois à venir. En tant qu’employé-e syndiqué-e, vous serez tenu-e d'adhérer au syndicat et bénéficierez des conditions énoncées dans la convention collective. Les cotisations syndicales seront exigées une fois que la convention collective sera en place.
Seuls les candidats sélectionnés pour les étapes suivantes du processus de recrutement seront contactés. Toutefois, tous les autres candidats seront ajoutés à notre base de données et pourront être pris en considération pour des opportunités futures.
À propos de DNEG
Nous sommes DNEG, l'un des principaux studios d'effets visuels et d'animation au monde pour la création de longs métrages primés, de contenu télévisuel et multiplateforme. Nous employons plus de 10 000 personnes avec des bureaux et des studios dans le monde entier: en Amérique du Nord (Los Angeles, Montréal, Toronto, Vancouver), en Europe (Londres), en Asie (Bangalore, Mohali, Chennai, Mumbai) et en Australie (Sydney).

DNEG Animation is a world-class studio that creates high-end animated feature films and episodic content for audiences all over the world. We’re growing our global crews to help deliver an exciting slate of major new projects. Join a team where the only house style is quality and work alongside some of the best talent in the business to help bring iconic characters and unique worlds to life. From complex graphic novel adaptations to beautifully-stylized films, each project is driven by the team's passion for the craft of animation and every role plays a huge part in the success of our shows. Feel inspired? Apply now to be part of the DNEG Animation team and come work with us on shows like ‘The Garfield Movie’, ‘Entergalactic’ and ‘Nimona’!
Job Description
The candidate will showcase the ability to interpret and transpose a character design in 3D. Character Modellers will be required to deliver outstanding models, both creatively and technically and ensure the delivery of assets within the time frame established.
Since each project is different and requires a unique artistic vision, the candidate will have to demonstrate high skills to adapt to any style or design and have a solid foundation on the technical aspects of character model creation.
Key Responsibilities
  • Create unique CG character models using provided reference material.
  • Submit your work to dailies and attend production reviews. Receive and address artistic and technical feedback.
  • Quality check your work before handing off to downstream depts using DNEG protocols.
  • Learn and become familiar with DNEG Modelling Dept workflows and pipeline tools.
  • Attend various project-specific reviews/discussions, department assembly, and other mandatory meetings.

Job Requirements
  • Experience working on feature animated films of varying artistic styles.
  • Production experience as a Character Modeller.
  • Good understanding of human anatomy and the ability to adapt to any organic lifeforms.
  • Ability to work closely with our Modelling Lead/Supervisor to ensure the quality and technical viability of character models for a production.
  • Ability to effectively translate your ideas, suggestions, and questions with other members of the team.
  • Digital sculpting experience with Maya and Z-brush.
  • Production experience in a modern ray-tracing or path-tracing rendering software like RenderMan or Arnold.
  • Strong sense of form, scale and proportion.

Additional Skills
  • Degree in Computer Animation or relevant course.
  • Knowledge of related software, such as Marvelous Designer.
Please note that this is a unionized position and will be covered by a collective agreement between DNEG and IATSE, in the coming months. As a unionized employee, you will be required to join the union and will benefit from the conditions set out in the collective agreement. Union dues will be required once the collective agreement is in place.
Only candidates selected for the next steps in the hiring process will be contacted. However, all other applicants will be added to our talent pool and may be considered for future opportunities.

description:

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern AI systems, multi-agent systems & frameworks, LLM-based architecture, and software engineering.

  • Architect and develop enterprise-scale multi-agent systems leveraging LLMs and autonomous agent frameworks using Google ADK, Agentspace, MCP, RAG, and A2A orchestration.

  • Optimize agents for orchestration, knowledge grounding, multi-step reasoning, and decision-making.
  • Design and implement distributed training workflows, online inference systems, and low latency serving architectures optimized for real-world performance, using Google cloud-native services.
  • Engineer scalable, secure, compliant and production-grade AI fabric and AI agent workflows using Vertex AI and modern cloud-native technologies.
  • Create reusable agent orchestration layers, observability hooks, and governance frameworks that accelerate Agentic AI adoption across TAG brands.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • BS in Computer Science, or related technology field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in Agentic AI engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, or platform engineering
  • Proven track record of building and deploying production-grade AI/ML systems at scale.
  • Deep understanding of modern AI model architectures (e.g., transformers, diffusion models) and system design.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Vertex AI (including model training, pipelines, orchestration, deployment, and monitoring) and Google’s Agentic AI stack.

  • Proficiency in Python, LLM integration workflows, MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool integration and A2A (Agent-to-Agent) orchestration for multi-agent workflows.
  • Expertise in distributed training, online inference, and low latency serving architectures.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Cloud Run, and Dataflow/PubSub for scalable deployment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI governance frameworks and responsible AI practices (Vertex AI Model Monitoring, BigQuery logging, Looker dashboards).
  • Contributions to open-source AI projects or publications in leading AI/ML conferences.
  • Experience with multi-modal models and advanced optimization strategies & frameworks.
  • Experience automating, architecting and governing production grade MLOps infrastructure to scale, optimize, and observe AI workloads.

title: Director of Total Rewards
description:
The Director of Total Rewards serves as the strategic leader responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the organization's total rewards philosophy and programs. This includes team member benefits, retirement plans, leave administration, wellness initiatives, team member advocacy, and related compliance functions.

This role is uniquely positioned at the intersection of organizational strategy and human care. The Director of Total Rewards leads a team dedicated to helping team members navigate some of life's most significant moments, including health challenges, family responsibilities, retirement planning, and personal well-being. As a result, success in this role requires exceptional emotional intelligence, empathy, compassion, and the ability to lead through service.

The Director partners closely with the CHRO and organizational leaders to ensure total rewards programs support team member attraction, retention, engagement, well-being, and organizational sustainability while fostering a culture where team members feel valued, supported, and connected to the mission.
Strategic Total Rewards Leadership
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive Total Rewards strategy aligned with organizational goals and workforce needs
  • Evaluate labor market trends, benchmarking data, and team member feedback to ensure competitive and sustainable programs.
  • Advise executive leadership regarding benefits design, retirement strategies, wellness initiatives, and workforce trends.
  • Identify innovative approaches that enhance team member well-being and engagement while balancing financial stewardship.
  • Establish metrics and reporting to evaluate program effectiveness and team member experience outcomes.
Benefits Administration
  • Provide strategic oversight of all team member benefit programs, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, voluntary benefits, FSAs, HSAs, retirement, and wellness programs.
  • Lead annual benefits strategy, renewals, open enrollment, and team member education initiatives.
  • Bring experience with unique, creative, and cost-effective benefit design approaches that enhance team member value while supporting organizational sustainability.
  • Oversee vendor relationships, broker partnerships, and third-party administrators.
  • Evaluate utilization data, claims experience, and emerging trends to drive informed decision-making.
  • Ensure high-quality benefit services and exceptional team member support.
Retirement Plan Administration
  • Oversee all retirement savings and financial wellness programs, including 403(b) plans.
  • Ensure compliance with ERISA, IRS, Department of Labor, and related regulatory requirements.
  • Provide leadership for retirement plan governance, audits, disclosures, and fiduciary processes.
  • Partner with investment advisors, recordkeepers, auditors, and legal counsel.
  • Promote retirement readiness through education and financial wellness initiatives.
Leave Administration and Workplace Support
  • Oversee all leave and accommodation programs, including FMLA, ADA, workers' compensation, disability programs, paid leave, and state-specific leave requirements.
  • Ensure compliant, consistent, and compassionate administration of leave programs.
  • Partner with leaders and HR staff to resolve complex leave and accommodation situations
  • Monitor trends and identify opportunities to improve team member experience and operational effectiveness.
  • Ensure team members navigating health concerns, family needs, or workplace challenges receive timely support and guidance.
Wellness and Well-Being
  • Lead the organization's wellness strategy and programming.
  • Develop initiatives that support physical, emotional, financial, social, and spiritual well-being.
  • Partner with organizational leaders to create a culture that prioritizes team member health and resilience.
  • Measure program participation and outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
Team Member Advocacy & Team Member Experience
  • Provide strategic oversight of the Team Member Advocacy function.
  • Ensure team members receive compassionate support when navigating benefits, leaves, workplace concerns, and organizational resources.
  • Establish service standards focused on responsiveness, care, respect, and problem resolution.
  • Collaborate with HR partners and leaders to identify systemic barriers impacting team member experience related total rewards.
  • Lead initiatives that strengthen engagement, belonging, retention, and overall workplace satisfaction.
  • Champion policies and programs that support the organization's commitment to caring for its people.
Leadership and Team Development
  • Lead, coach, develop, and inspire the Benefits Manager, Leave & Wellness Specialist, and Team Member Advocate.
  • Foster a collaborative, service-oriented culture focused on trust, accountability, compassion, and excellence.
  • Develop future leaders through mentoring, coaching, and succession planning.
  • Establish clear expectations, performance goals, and measures of success.
  • Promote innovation, continuous improvement, and team member-centered problem solving.
Compliance and Risk Management
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local laws governing benefits, leaves, retirement plans, privacy, and employment practices.
  • Maintain policies, processes, and controls that minimize organizational risk.
  • Oversee audits, reporting requirements, regulatory filings, and plan documentation.
  • Stay current on emerging legislation and regulatory updates affecting total rewards programs.
Financial Stewardship
  • Develop and manage benefit and total rewards budgets.
  • Partner with Finance to oversee forecasting, cost management, and program sustainability.
  • Analyze return on investment and program effectiveness.
  • Balance fiscal responsibility with team member value and organizational mission.

Required
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field. (Open to working experience in lieu of a degree).
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in benefits, leave administration, retirement programs, total rewards, or human resources leadership.
  • Minimum of 3 years leading and developing professional-level team members.
  • Experience managing complex benefits and retirement programs.
  • Experience with team member leave administration, accommodations, and regulatory compliance.
Preferred
  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Leadership, or related field.
  • Healthcare, senior living, nonprofit, or multi-site employer experience.
  • CEBS, SHRM-SCP, SPHR, or other related certifications.
  • Experience with innovative health plan strategies, including Reference Based Pricing models, is a plus.

Critical Leadership Competencies

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates exceptional self-awareness, empathy, active listening, and interpersonal effectiveness. Responds thoughtfully to difficult situations while maintaining professionalism, trust, and compassion.


Compassionate Leadership

Approaches team member concerns with kindness, dignity, respect, and genuine care. Creates an environment where team members feel heard, supported, and valued.


Relationship Building

Develops strong partnerships across all levels of the organization and builds credibility through trust, transparency, and follow-through.


Courageous Communication

Addresses difficult issues directly, respectfully, and constructively while balancing organizational needs with team member well-being.


Strategic Thinking

Connects people programs to organizational goals and effectively translates strategy into action.

  • Competitive pay and bonus opportunities
  • 6-weeks of paid Flexible Time Off (FTO)
  • Emotionally intelligent and team-member-first leadership
  • Health, Vision, Dental, Retirement, and Wellness Programs

You will have the opportunity to influence organizational culture, improve team member well-being, and make a daily difference in the lives of team members across the organization.

The work is meaningful. The mission matters. The people matter.

If you are a compassionate, emotionally intelligent leader who believes that taking care of team members is one of the most important responsibilities of an organization, we would love to hear from you.

Join us as we create exceptional experiences for the people who dedicate their lives to caring for others.

Full‑time (38 - 40 hours/week) Monday–Friday, rotating Saturday coverage

Applications will be accepted through August 28, 2026. Candidates selected to move forward will participate in a multi-step interview process. We encourage interested applicants to apply early, as review of applications may begin before the posting closes.

title: Service Assistant - Rolling Stock
description:

Shifts: Permanent Nights Rotating Shift Pattern (Flexibility to work weekends)
Hours Per Week: Average 40hrs per week

Start Date: ASAP

Europe's largest Rolling Stock Producer, maintainer and servicing organisation is looking for Mechanical Experienced Engineers to join a well established team at a busy rail depot in the Midlands.

General engine serving duties, including oil, fuel fitters and hydro static oil to laid down Vehicle Maintenance Instructions (VMI). * Refuelling

* Flexible and committed team member that works well as part of team.
* Accurate and efficient worker.
* Attention to details.
* Some basic Mechanical Engineering knowledge.

Candidates from the following background will be considered:
* RAF, REME, Army, Navy
* Plant Maintenance
* Engineering Services Maintenance
* Rail
* Heavy Mechanical Engineering
* Automotive

Ideal applicants would have had some heavy maintenance experience and previously worked shifts. Ideally would also have a NVQ level 2 in Engineering, although this is not essential.

description:
Site Contracts Lead/Sr Lead - Sponsor-dedicated

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Establishes, maintains and updates training material for site contracts lead team and site contract negotiators.
  • Serves as subject matter expert within the organization equipped to help resolve global site contracting issues, and escalation point within the Company for internal customers to seek assistance.
  • Oversees negotiations of clinical study agreements (CTA´s) on a study level and drives CTA document finalization and execution, including contractual language & terms, financial attachments, and investigator grant budgets in collaboration with a global team of site contract & budget negotiators.
  • Provides oversight of contact & budget negotiations status and manages escalation of out-of-parameter queries on budgetary and contractual requests to sponsor decision-makers in all regions of study conduct. Provides consultation during escalation of out-of-parameter queries as needed.
  • Advises study team and Sponsor stakeholders on industry trends, norms, and emergent developments surrounding site contract and budgetary negotiations. Provides consultation on potential risks and mitigation tactics for negotiation issues pertaining to overall study start-up needs.
  • Acts as first-line subject matter expert for all such CTA elements on assigned studies for internal and sponsor stakeholders alike. Advises stakeholders on issue resolution within the context of assigned studies. May seek additional support from internal support structures as needed.
  • Plans contract execution strategy for assigned studies—including forecast of site-specific contractual execution timelines with as much accuracy as possible—and coordinates with internal study team stakeholders to ensure that CTA strategy is aligned with overall study start-up plans and expectations overall. Manages expectations of internal and sponsor study team regarding global CTA negotiations for assigned studies.
  • Coordinates communications between study team stakeholders and global team of site-facing site contract & budget negotiators including roll-up of all status updates to regular team forum. Participates in regular study calls to facilitate communication as needed.
  • Works closely with internal stakeholders and with Sponsor to prepare site contractual templates, including payment terms, and study-level negotiation parameters and processes within Company standards in order to drive successful negotiation of contracts and budgets.
  • Establishes strong working relationships and collaboration with Sponsor to ensure site contractual templates fit into the global strategy set for the program.
  • Identifies possible site contractual and investigator budgetary document or process operational risk and proactively works to provide solutions. Establishes strong working relationships with customer and internal project teams. Escalates deviations to senior management and is equipped to resolve issues with Quality Assurance.
  • Creates and maintains document status reports, and updates department tools/systems and team members on a regular basis; ensures appropriate documentation is maintained.
  • Collaborates with internal and external legal, finance and clinical operations departments, including communicating and explaining legal and budgetary issues.
  • Manages site and study level discussions with internal and sponsor team stakeholders around fair market value of investigator budgets and payment terms within corporate and industry standards during negotiation with sites.
  • Identifies best practices, investigates root causes of fundamental issues and problems for projects and recommends solutions.
  • Trains and mentors less experienced staff members on department Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), processes, tools and templates and ensures quality of teamwork products.
  • May support BU and organization through help desk and other defined pathways to resolve and deescalate issues.
  • May identify and lead internal team training and/or process improvement initiatives.
  • Participates in business development presentations as a subject matter expert in site contracts and investigator budget management within the Company
  • Performs other work-related duties as assigned. Minimal travel may be required (up to 25%)

Qualifications:

  • BS degree in life sciences, a health related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong experience in a CRO/pharmaceutical industry and related clinical trial expertise (Study Coordinator, CRA, Pharmacy, Nursing, Healthcare Administration) or site start-up experience.
  • Thorough knowledge of applicable regulations, drug development and clinical project management procedures. Strong presentation, documentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint), MS Project, outlook and Internet.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines, delivering high quality work in a dynamic environment.
  • Above-average attention to detail, effective oral/written communication skills along with the ability to work independently to meet deadlines.
  • Strong leadership skills; ability to teach/mentor team members. Ability to coach employees to reach performance objectives.
  • Strong background in issue resolution, meeting customer deliverables and driving best practices at organization or customer portfolio level.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. title: Gryps — Senior Software Engineer
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Gryps — Senior Software Engineer

Type: Full-time | Hybrid | New York, NY Compensation: $220K–$270K + competitive equity Hiring count: 2 Visa sponsorship: No — not open to any visas (US citizens / Green Card holders only) Reports to: Amir Tasbihi, Cofounder & CTO

About Gryps

Gryps is building the AI platform for construction capital program owners — fully managed knowledge graphs, AI agents, and automation for a massive industry that's barely been touched by modern software. The platform collects, organizes, and analyzes data and documents so owners can make better decisions and cut manual work managing capital projects.

Founded: 2020 | Team size: 20 | Total funding: $7.7M (seed) Backers: Primary Venture Partners, Pear VC, Flybridge, LDV Capital Industry: AI, Construction, Software Development Website: gryps.io Office: Tower 49, Midtown Manhattan, New York, NY

Why Candidates Should Join

  • Own the platform: Fully managed knowledge graphs, AI agents, and automation for a giant industry untouched by modern software.
  • Well-backed, lean, and AI-native: $7.7M seed from Primary, Pear VC, Flybridge, and LDV. A 20-person team that cut engineering from 12 to 5 and lifted output 4–5x through AI-native workflows.
  • Clear leadership path: Senior IC role with a defined path to Lead Engineer within 3–6 months.
  • Real ownership: Engineers wear multiple hats, take broad ownership, and shape both product and engineering culture.

Intake Call Summary

  • Role: Senior Software Engineer / Tech Lead — prove IC value and grow into an engineering lead.
  • Candidate bar: Startup experience, ideally founding engineers or tech leads; strong Python + AWS; flexible, wears multiple hats, comfortable with startup ambiguity.
  • Company context: Team reduced from 12 to 5, AI-heavy development; culture values flexibility and a generalist mindset.
  • Comp & logistics: Stated on the call as $200K–$250K base + equity (see conflict note below); hybrid NYC, 2–3 days in office (see conflict note below).
  • Timeline: Hire two, ideally promote one to engineering lead in 6–12 months. Interview process = technical + in-person cultural.
  • Pain points: Prior eng recruiting has been hard; needs someone who adapts quickly and adds value fast.
  • Ideal profile: Product mindset + strong communication; early/mid-stage SaaS experience highly valued.
  • Technical: Python essential, AWS highly preferred; backend crucial, frontend a plus but not required.

Data conflicts to resolve:

  1. Salary — Intake call states $200K–$250K base; the posted role details and submission form state $220K–$270K. Using $220K–$270K as authoritative pending confirmation.
  2. In-office days — Intake call says "2–3 days"; the Must-have requirement, hybrid policy, and role details all say 3 days/week. Using 3 days/week as authoritative pending confirmation.

The Role

A deeply technical IC who thrives in early-stage environments — shipping production backend services, making architectural decisions, and mentoring junior engineers, with a clear path to Lead Engineer within 3–6 months.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Designing, building, and operating production-grade backend services and data pipelines using Python and AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, serverless architectures)
  • Making critical architectural and system design decisions while leveraging AI coding tools (like Claude) to accelerate development
  • Owning features end-to-end from backend to front end (React), eliminating handoffs in a ~90% backend / 10% frontend codebase
  • Engaging directly with customers and forward-deployed engineers to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and translate ambiguous needs into shipped software
  • Mentoring junior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing

Tech stack: Python, AWS, AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, REST APIs, Microservices, Databases, React, Serverless, Event-driven architecture, JSON, XML, CSV

Qualifications

Seniority

  • 5+ years of experience in backend software engineering [Required]

Work Experience

  • Founding engineer or early employee at a B2B SaaS startup (first ~10 hires, seed/Series A stage) [Must have]
  • Owned production backend systems end-to-end (not just contributed) [Required]
  • Prior tech lead or mentorship role guiding junior engineers [Strongly preferred]

Education

  • BS in Computer Science or related STEM degree [Required]
  • A lack of degree is acceptable, only if strong startup engineering track record [Strongly preferred]

Hard Skills

  • Advanced Python expertise for production backend systems [Must have]
  • Strong hands-on AWS experience (Lambda, Step Functions, serverless) [Required]
  • Experience with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows [Strongly preferred]

Soft Skills

  • Product-minded; willing to talk to customers and clarify requirements directly [Required]

Miscellaneous

  • Based in or near New York City; 3 days/week in-office (Midtown) [Must have]

Traits to Avoid

  • Only large-company experience with no startup or early-stage exposure
  • Job hopper: multiple stints under one year with no clear narrative

Role Details

  • Salary | $220K–$270K
  • Equity | Competitive equity
  • On-site policy | Hybrid — 3 days/week in-office, Midtown NYC (Tower 49, near Grand Central)
  • Visa sponsorship | Not open to any visas (US citizens / Green Card holders only)
  • Employment type | Full-time
  • Location | New York, NY

Screening Questions

  1. Are you able to work in New York and come into the office 3 times per week?
  2. Describe your experience as a founding engineer or early employee at a startup: what did you own and how scrappy did you have to be?
  3. Do you have any experience with, and are you willing to be in front of, customers / talk to non-engineers?
  4. Can you be on-site? If not, are you willing to relocate?
  5. What is your salary expectation?
  6. How actively are you exploring new opportunities?

Interview Process

Stage 1 — Submit candidate After submission, you're notified if the hiring manager wants to proceed.

Stage 2 — Initial Screen (30 minutes) Intro call with Amir (CTO/Co-founder) to sell the candidate on the company vision, explain the value of what Gryps has built, assess startup mindset and cultural fit, and gauge mutual interest.

Stage 3 — Technical Interview (90–120 minutes) Combined technical session covering high-level coding concepts (not syntax-focused), a code review exercise, and a deep-dive into architecture and system design. Evaluates the candidate's ability to guide AI-generated code, verify and review it, and make sound architectural decisions. Conducted by the engineering team.

Stage 4 — Culture Fit Interview

Stage 5 — Onsite Interview (60 minutes) In-person at the Gryps office in NY with Amir and his co-founder, plus other team members. Evaluates cultural fit, flexibility, startup mindset, willingness to wear different hats, and interpersonal dynamics.

Stage 6 — Offer Extended

Stage 7 — Candidate Hired

Ideal Companies & Backgrounds

Updated Aug 18, 2026

Seed to Series B AI/ML startups with Python + AWS backends (scrappy builders with agentic/NLP experience) Hebbia, Glean, Vectara, Unstructured, LlamaIndex, Cohere, Weights & Biases, Anyscale, Modal Labs, Baseten

title: Data Architect
description:
Data Architect - SC Cleared

£650 p/d Outside IR35
Remote, occasional London travel
October Start - 6 months, extension expected


We are recruiting a Data Architect to support a major data modernisation programme within a complex central government environment. The role will focus on data retention and deletion, helping establish the governance, architecture and controls required as the organisation transitions its data estate to a modern cloud-based platform. This position combines data architecture and management expertise with extensive stakeholder engagement across technical, operational, policy and compliance teams.

Role responsibilities

  • Define and maintain data architecture principles, standards and guardrails covering data retention, deletion and lifecycle management.
  • Support the development and implementation of global and local data-retention approaches across multiple products and data domains.
  • Contribute to the alpha phase of a data estate modernisation programme, qualifying use cases, validating requirements and testing architectural assumptions.
  • Work with architecture and engineering teams to embed retention and deletion controls across different layers of the target data platform.
  • Advise product and delivery teams on non-compliant datasets, required remediation and appropriate data-management practices.
  • Lead engagement with technical, compliance, policy and operational stakeholders to resolve dependencies and progress decisions.
  • Produce and review architecture documentation, data models, requirements, options papers and materials for governance forums.
  • Track risks, issues and decisions, ensuring data-management concerns are clearly reported and escalated where required.

Key experience and requirements

  • Active SC clearance, with sufficient validity to support the initial contract term.
  • Experience working as a Data Architect, Data Solutions Architect or Data Management Architect within a large or regulated organisation.
  • Strong knowledge of data governance, retention, deletion, metadata, data lineage and lifecycle-management principles.
  • Experience defining data architecture standards, controls and reusable patterns for cloud or enterprise data platforms.
  • Ability to translate policy, compliance and business requirements into practical technical guardrails.
  • Experience engaging stakeholders across architecture, engineering, product, compliance and policy functions.
  • Knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and architectural approaches; Databricks and medallion architecture experience would be beneficial but is not essential.
  • Familiarity with data modelling, data catalogues, master data management or governance tooling such as Informatica Axon and Enterprise Data Catalog would be advantageous.

title: Virtual General Practitioner (GP)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

VIRTUAL GENERAL PRACTITIONER (GP)

Location: Remote

Role Engagement: Part-Time

ABOUT THE THRIVE CENTER

The Thrive Center is positioned as Bermuda's primary medicinal cannabis center, dedicated to providing patients with safe, lawful and dignified access to quality-assured medicinal cannabis under the guidance of qualified healthcare professionals.

The Thrive Center provides services and products in accordance with its current licence and applicable requirements. The Center is committed to maintaining appropriate professional standards, documentation, internal controls and procedures in relation to its operations.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Thrive Medical is seeking an experienced UK-resident General Practitioner (GP) to provide virtual medical consultations and ongoing clinical support to patients of Thrive Medical in Bermuda.

The position is designed to expand patient access outside of normal clinic hours. The GP will work remotely from the United Kingdom, primarily during UK evenings and weekends, providing convenient coverage during Bermuda daytime and evening hours.

The successful candidate will provide safe, professional and patient-centred virtual medical care while working within Thrive Medical’s established clinical protocols and governance framework.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The Virtual GP will:

  • Conduct scheduled and, where appropriate, same-day video and telephone consultations with Thrive patients.
  • Assess common acute and chronic medical complaints suitable for virtual management.
  • Review patient medical histories, medications, allergies, laboratory results and other available clinical information.
  • Provide clinical advice, treatment recommendations and appropriate follow-up.
  • Manage routine primary-care conditions that can safely be treated through telemedicine.
  • Provide follow-up consultations for existing Thrive patients.
  • Review laboratory and diagnostic results and communicate appropriate recommendations to patients.
  • Identify patients requiring physical examination, diagnostic testing, emergency assessment or in-person physician review and arrange/escalate appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate, timely and comprehensive electronic medical records for every patient interaction.
  • Work collaboratively with Thrive’s Bermuda-based physicians, nurses, pharmacists and administrative team.
  • Participate in appropriate clinical handover where patients require ongoing care from the Bermuda team.
  • Follow Thrive Medical clinical protocols, prescribing policies, safeguarding procedures, privacy requirements and quality standards.

PRESCRIBING

Where legally and professionally permitted, the physician may recommend or prescribe medications appropriate to the patient’s clinical condition.

All prescribing must comply with applicable Bermuda legislation, professional licensing requirements and Thrive Medical prescribing protocols.

Where prescribing authority is restricted because of jurisdiction or registration requirements, the Virtual GP will document the recommended treatment plan for review and prescribing by an appropriately licensed Bermuda physician.

WORKING SCHEDULE

The service will primarily operate during:

  • Monday–Friday: UK evening hours
    Saturday–Sunday: Flexible daytime/evening coverage
  • The exact rota will be agreed with the successful candidate.
  • Because Bermuda is several hours behind the United Kingdom, UK evening availability provides useful afternoon and early-evening coverage for Thrive patients in Bermuda.
  • The role may initially be structured around scheduled consultation blocks with the opportunity to expand hours as patient demand grows.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS

Candidates must:

  • Hold a recognised medical degree (MBBS, MBChB or equivalent).
  • Be registered with the UK General Medical Council (GMC) with a licence to practise.
  • Have appropriate experience in General Practice / Primary Care.
  • Have experience independently assessing and managing patients.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English.
  • Be comfortable providing consultations by video and telephone.
  • Be comfortable working with electronic medical records and digital healthcare systems.
  • Demonstrate appropriate clinical judgement regarding the limitations of virtual medicine and when patients require face-to-face or emergency assessment.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Preference will be given to candidates with:

  • Current or previous NHS General Practice experience.
  • MRCGP or equivalent postgraduate General Practice qualification.
  • Previous telemedicine/virtual-care experience.
  • Experience managing chronic disease, men’s and women’s health, dermatological complaints, pain, sleep disorders and general primary-care presentations.
  • Experience working in private healthcare or international healthcare environments.

PROFESSIONAL REQUIREMENTS

The successful physician will be expected to maintain:

  • GMC registration and licence to practise.
  • Appropriate professional indemnity/medical malpractice coverage for the services being provided.
  • Continuing professional development and appraisal/revalidation requirements.
  • Patient confidentiality and professional standards consistent with Thrive Medical policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Any additional registration, licensing or approval required to provide medical care to patients located in Bermuda must be established before independent clinical practice begins.

TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS

The physician must have:

  • Reliable high-speed internet.
  • A private and confidential workspace.
  • Computer with camera and microphone suitable for video consultations.
  • Ability to securely access Thrive Medical’s electronic medical record and telemedicine systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This position would suit an experienced GP looking for flexible, remote clinical work outside traditional UK daytime practice hours.

The role provides an opportunity to work with an established Bermuda healthcare service while remaining based in the United Kingdom and delivering care entirely virtually.

title: AWS Cloud Data Engineer
description:
English proficiency is mandatory.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled AWS Cloud Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and automated cloud data platforms.

This role will be responsible for developing data pipelines, managing cloud infrastructure, and supporting analytics and machine learning workloads across the AWS ecosystem.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with modern AWS data services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and distributed data processing technologies, along with a strong understanding of cloud architecture and DevOps best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, cloud-native data pipelines using AWS Glue, Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, AWS Lambda, and Amazon S3.
  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows using PySpark and AWS Glue.
  • Develop, deploy, and support machine learning workflows using Amazon SageMaker.
  • Build and manage containerized applications and batch workloads using AWS Fargate.
  • Provision, manage, and automate cloud infrastructure using Terraform and OpenTofu, following Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices.
  • Design and optimize data storage solutions using Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 to support analytics and reporting workloads.
  • Implement and maintain event-driven architectures using Amazon SQS and other AWS messaging services.
  • Develop and support secure, automated CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize AWS services to ensure high availability, performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, software developers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, end-to-end data solutions.
  • Follow cloud security, governance, and operational best practices, including IAM, encryption, logging, and monitoring.

The successful candidate will collaborate with stakeholders across Operations, individual business units, and external partners to define and execute scalable, secure, and cost-effective network and cloud strategies. title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a highly analytical and technically proficient Business Analyst to support the Lumen Connect digital platform and Ask Lumen AI initiatives. This role will be responsible for defining success metrics, building measurement frameworks, delivering actionable insights, and developing reporting solutions that drive product decisions, customer experience improvements, adoption, and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate is not limited to traditional reporting tools. They can leverage modern analytics platforms, AI-powered tools, coding assistants, and custom development techniques to rapidly build dashboards, automate analysis, and uncover business insights from complex data sources. The role supports key initiatives focused on portal adoption, customer engagement, self-service effectiveness, and AI experience optimization.

The Main Responsibilities

Analytics Strategy & KPI Development

  • Define and maintain business and product KPIs for Lumen Connect and Ask Lumen.
  • Establish measurement frameworks aligned with product objectives and business outcomes.
  • Develop executive scorecards and operational reporting that provide visibility into platform performance.
  • Identify leading and lagging indicators that measure customer adoption, engagement, self-service success, and business value.

Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and analytics solutions for product, operations, customer support, and executive stakeholders.
  • Create reporting solutions using Power BI, Adobe Analytics, SQL, Python, APIs, and custom analytics applications.
  • Build self-service reporting capabilities that enable business users to access data independently.
  • Automate reporting processes and reduce manual data preparation activities.

AI & Digital Experience Analytics

  • Measure and analyze Ask Lumen AI adoption, engagement, usage patterns, escalation trends, customer feedback, and business outcomes.
  • Analyze digital customer journeys across Lumen Connect to identify friction points and improvement opportunities.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of self-service capabilities, customer workflows, and AI-assisted experiences.
  • Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Perform detailed analysis of customer behavior, portal usage, feature adoption, engagement, and operational processes.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities within large datasets.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into actionable business recommendations.
  • Support product planning and prioritization through data-driven insights.

Technology & Innovation

  • Leverage AI-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, coding assistants, and other generative AI technologies to accelerate analytics development and insight generation.
  • Build custom dashboards, analytics applications, data integrations, and automated reporting solutions using modern development approaches.
  • Utilize APIs, cloud platforms, SQL, Python, and AI-assisted development tools to solve business problems when standard reporting platforms are insufficient.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging analytics and AI technologies that can improve reporting efficiency and business intelligence capabilities.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis, product analytics, digital analytics, or business intelligence.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI, Adobe Analytics, or similar analytics platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience translating business questions into measurable metrics and reporting frameworks.
  • Ability to communicate insights effectively to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital product analytics, customer experience analytics, or SaaS platforms.
  • Experience with Python, APIs, data integration, and automation.
  • Experience building custom analytics applications or data products.
  • Experience using AI-powered development and productivity tools.
  • Knowledge of web analytics, digital customer journeys, and user behavior analysis.
  • Experience supporting AI-enabled products, conversational AI, or customer self-service platforms.
  • Experience working within agile product development environments.

Success Measures

This role will be expected to drive measurable improvements in:
  • Lumen Connect adoption and engagement
  • Customer self-service utilization
  • Feature adoption and usage trends
  • Digital customer experience
  • Ask Lumen AI adoption and effectiveness
  • Executive reporting maturity
  • Data-driven decision making
  • Reporting automation and operational efficiency
  • Customer satisfaction and business outcomes
Ideal Profile: Someone who combines the mindset of a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Data Analyst, and AI-enabled developer. This person should be comfortable moving from executive presentations and KPI discussions to writing SQL, using Copilot to generate code, building custom dashboards, and creating automated analytics solutions that deliver business value.
